def spawn_step270(prim_path,cfg,translation=None,orientation=None,**kwargs):

def mesh_query(env):
    if not hasattr(env,'_step270_ray'):env._step270_ray=AuthoredTerrainRaycast(env.sim.stage,env.device)
    return env._step270_ray

def out_of_authored_floor(env):
    # The finite global floor is part of the existing authored mesh, not a new distance limit.
    root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_pos_w)
    if not torch.isfinite(root).all():raise RuntimeError('Nonfinite root position at terrain boundary guard')
    origins=env.scene.env_origins
    lower=origins[:,:2].amin(0)-2.5;upper=origins[:,:2].amax(0)+2.5
    return ((root[:,:2]<lower)|(root[:,:2]>upper)).any(-1)

def save_bad_terrain_query(env,points,q,kind):
    from pathlib import Path
    finite=torch.isfinite(q['height'])&torch.isfinite(q['normal']).all(-1)
    valid=q['hit']&finite
    if kind=='root_ground':valid&=q['normal'][...,2]>0
    bad=torch.nonzero(~valid,as_tuple=False)
    def finite_list(value):
        def clean(x):
            if isinstance(x,list):return [clean(v) for v in x]
            return x if not isinstance(x,float) or np.isfinite(x) else None
        return clean(value.detach().cpu().tolist())
    rows=[]
    for env_id,ray_id in bad.detach().cpu().tolist():
        rows.append(dict(env=env_id,ray=ray_id,actual_start=finite_list(points[env_id,ray_id]),hit=bool(q['hit'][env_id,ray_id]),height=finite_list(q['height'][env_id,ray_id]),normal=finite_list(q['normal'][env_id,ray_id]),distance=finite_list(q['distance'][env_id,ray_id]),face_id=int(q['face_id'][env_id,ray_id])))

def ground_height(env):
    r=env.scene['robot'];points=tensor(r.data.root_pos_w)[:,None,:].clone();points[:,:,2]+=1.

def wheel_bounds(env):
    robot=env.scene['robot'];pos=tensor(robot.data.body_pos_w);quat=tensor(robot.data.body_quat_w);lows=[];highs=[]
    for indices in env.h1_wheel_shapes:
        low=[];high=[]
        for si in indices:
            s=env.h1_shapes[si];q=quat[:,s['body_index']];x,y,z,w=q.unbind(-1)
            R=torch.stack((torch.stack((1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-w*z),2*(x*z+w*y)),-1),torch.stack((2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x)),-1),torch.stack((2*(x*z-w*y),2*(y*z+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)),-1)),-2)
            L=torch.tensor(s['linear_body_from_shape'],device=env.device,dtype=pos.dtype);t=torch.tensor(s['origin_body_m'],device=env.device,dtype=pos.dtype);row=R@L;center=pos[:,s['body_index']]+(R@t[:,None]).squeeze(-1)
            if s['type'] in ('Cylinder','Capsule'):
                axis=row[:,:,s['axis']].abs();norm2=row.square().sum(-1);radial=(norm2-axis.square()).clamp_min(0).sqrt();extent=axis*s['height']*.5+(norm2.sqrt() if s['type']=='Capsule' else radial)*s['radius'];a=center-extent;b=center+extent
            elif s['type']=='Cube':extent=row.abs().sum(-1)*s['size']*.5;a=center-extent;b=center+extent
            elif s['type']=='Mesh':
                points=torch.tensor(s['points'],device=env.device,dtype=pos.dtype);v=row@points.T;a=center+v.amin(-1);b=center+v.amax(-1)
            else:raise ValueError('Unqualified wheel collider '+s['type'])
            low.append(a);high.append(b)
        lows.append(torch.stack(low).amin(0));highs.append(torch.stack(high).amax(0))
    return torch.stack(lows,1),torch.stack(highs,1)

class Step270Phase:

    def begin_control(self):self.request_for_action.copy_(self.public_request());self.event_control.zero_();self.progress_control.zero_()

    def reset(self,ids):

    def physical(self,**kw):

        out=self.goal.physical(request=self.request_for_action,ground_ready=prepared,nonwheel_clean=(kw['nonwheel_max_N']<=1)&torch.where((kw['wheel_N']<=1).all(-1),kw['all_min_clear_m']>0,kw['all_min_clear_m']>=-.001),known_integrity=torch.ones(self.n,device=self.device,dtype=torch.bool),wheel_N=kw['wheel_N'],wheel_bottom_world_z=lo[:,:,2],wheel_contact_platform=top,wheel_footprints_inside_top=inside,both_wheel_edge_crossed=self.crossed.all(-1),root_vz=kw['root_vz'],planar_speed=kw['root_planar_speed'],roll=kw['roll'],pitch=kw['pitch'],heading_error=kw['yaw']-self.yaw_reference)

    def state_dict(self):

def step_rate(env,name):
    p=getattr(env,'h1_phase',None)
    if not isinstance(p,Step270Phase):return torch.zeros(env.num_envs,device=env.device)
    root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_state_w)
    if name=='release_shortfall':return (p.request_for_action&p.attempt&~p.launched).float()*(p.release_reference_vz-root[:,9]).clamp_min(0)
    if name=='landing_yaw_rate':return p.landed.float()*tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_ang_vel_b)[:,2].square()
    if name=='landing_planar_stop':return p.landed.float()*root[:,7:9].square().sum(-1)
    raise ValueError(name)

    from isaaclab.managers import RewardTermCfg
    cfg.rewards.h1_prelaunch_progress.weight=0.
    for name in ('flight_vz','flight','takeoff_extend'):getattr(cfg.rewards,'h1_scut_fudan_'+name).weight=0.
    for name,weight in [('release_shortfall',-2.),('landing_yaw_rate',-1.),('landing_planar_stop',-2.)]:setattr(cfg.rewards,'h1_step270_'+name,RewardTermCfg(func=step_rate,weight=weight,params={'name':name}))
    configure_path_reward(cfg)
    task.ground_height=ground_height
    return configure_scene(cfg)

class LifetimeGoalCounter:
    def __init__(self,initial_counts,initial_crossed):
        self.before={k:np.asarray(initial_counts[k]).copy() for k in EVENTS};self.n=len(self.before[EVENTS[0]])
        assert all(a.shape==(self.n,) and a.dtype.kind in 'iu' and (a>=0).all() for a in self.before.values())
        self.initial_sums={k:int(a.sum()) for k,a in self.before.items()}
        self.before_cross=np.asarray(initial_crossed,dtype=bool).copy();assert self.before_cross.shape==(self.n,2)
        self.total={k:0 for k in EVENTS};self.by_env={k:np.zeros(self.n,dtype=np.uint64) for k in EVENTS}
        self.cross_by_env=np.zeros(self.n,dtype=np.uint64);self.rows=0;self.negative_counter_envframes=0
        self.invalid_rows=0;self.last_error=None;self.write_errors=[]
        self.landing_journal=LandingEventJournal(self.n)

    def complete(self,row):
        try:
            after={k:np.asarray(row[k]) for k in EVENTS};done=np.asarray(row['done'],dtype=bool);cross=np.asarray(row['step_wheel_crossed'],dtype=bool)
            if done.shape!=(self.n,) or cross.shape!=(self.n,2):raise ValueError('Counter row shape')
            if not all(a.shape==(self.n,) and a.dtype.kind in 'iu' and (a>=0).all() for a in after.values()):raise ValueError('Counter row integer schema')
            deltas={k:a.astype(np.int64)-self.before[k].astype(np.int64) for k,a in after.items()}
        except (KeyError,ValueError,TypeError) as error:
            self.invalid_rows+=1;self.last_error=type(error).__name__+': '+str(error);return False
        for k,delta in deltas.items():
            self.negative_counter_envframes+=int((delta<0).sum());delta=np.maximum(delta,0).astype(np.uint64)
            self.total[k]+=int(delta.sum(dtype=np.uint64));self.by_env[k]+=delta
            self.before[k]=after[k].copy();self.before[k][done]=0
        self.cross_by_env+=(cross.all(-1)&~self.before_cross.all(-1)).astype(np.uint64)
        self.before_cross=cross.copy();self.before_cross[done]=False;self.rows+=1
        self.landing_journal.complete(row,np.flatnonzero(deltas['landing_count']>0),deltas['landing_count'],self.rows)
        return True

    def snapshot(self):
        return {'schema':'completed_control_goal_events_v1','complete_control_rows':self.rows,'num_envs':self.n,
                'environment_control_transitions':self.rows*self.n,'events':dict(self.total),'initial_counter_snapshot_sums':self.initial_sums,
                'unique_env_ids_with_event':{k:int((a>0).sum()) for k,a in self.by_env.items()},
                'both_leading_edges_cross_event_count':int(self.cross_by_env.sum()),'negative_counter_envframes':self.negative_counter_envframes,
                'invalid_rows':self.invalid_rows,'last_error':self.last_error,'diagnostic_valid':self.invalid_rows==0 and self.negative_counter_envframes==0,
                'diagnostic_write_errors':list(self.write_errors),'selected_resets_accounted_from_previous_complete_row_done':True,
                'only_completed_control_rows_not_partial_physics_callbacks':True,
                'cross_event_is_original_leading_edge_truth_not_complete_footprint_landing':True,
                'not_frozen_policy_skill_graduation_or_new_training_gate':True}

    def save(self,folder):
        p=Path(folder)/'CONTROL_LIFETIME_GOAL_EVENTS_ACTUAL.json';tmp=p.with_suffix('.json.partial')
        try:
            tmp.write_text(json.dumps(self.snapshot(),indent=2),encoding='utf8');os.replace(tmp,p);self.landing_journal.save(folder);return True
        except OSError as error:

class LandingEventJournal:
    FIELDS=('root13','q30','joint_velocity','applied_torque','executed6','raw_sampled6','history5ms','impulse','public_request','step_stable_ticks','step_success','step_wheel_crossed','takeoff_count','landing_count','recovery_count','episode','done')
    def __init__(self,n,pre=16,post=64,cap=64):
        from collections import deque
        self.n=n;self.pre=pre;self.post=post;self.cap=cap;self.ring=deque(maxlen=pre)
        self.cases=[];self.last_control=0;self.landing_records_seen=0;self.landing_delta_seen=0;self.skipped_cap=0;self.errors=[];self.write_errors=[]
    def _copy(self,row,env):
        out={}
        for name in self.FIELDS:
            a=row[name]
            if not isinstance(a,np.ndarray) or a.shape[0]!=self.n or a.dtype.kind not in 'biuf':raise ValueError('Journal row schema '+name)
            value=np.asarray(a[env]).copy()
            if not np.isfinite(value).all():raise ValueError('Journal selected nonfinite '+name)
            out[name]=value
        return out
    def _error(self,error,control):
        if len(self.errors)<16:self.errors.append(dict(type=type(error).__name__,message=str(error),control=control))
    def complete(self,row,landing_ids,landing_deltas,control):
        if control!=self.last_control+1:
            self._error(ValueError('Journal nonsequential completed control'),control);return False
        self.last_control=control
        try:
            for case in self.cases:
                if case['closed_reason'] is not None:continue
                e=case['env_id']
                if int(row['episode'][e])!=case['episode']:
                    case['closed_reason']='episode_changed_censored';continue
                case['rows'].append(self._copy(row,e));case['controls'].append(control);case['post_rows']+=1
                if bool(row['done'][e]):case['closed_reason']='selected_reset_censored'
                elif case['post_rows']>=self.post:case['closed_reason']='post_control_limit'
            for e0 in landing_ids:
                e=int(e0);self.landing_records_seen+=1;self.landing_delta_seen+=int(landing_deltas[e])
                if len(self.cases)>=self.cap:self.skipped_cap+=1;continue
                event=self._copy(row,e);episode=int(row['episode'][e]);pre=[]
                for no,old in reversed(self.ring):
                    if int(old['episode'][e])!=episode or bool(old['done'][e]):break
                    pre.append((no,self._copy(old,e)))
                pre.reverse();case=dict(case_id=len(self.cases),env_id=e,episode=episode,landing_control=control,landing_counter_delta=int(landing_deltas[e]),rows=[x[1] for x in pre]+[event],controls=[x[0] for x in pre]+[control],pre_rows=len(pre),post_rows=0,closed_reason='selected_reset_at_landing_censored' if bool(row['done'][e]) else None,versions=[])
                self.cases.append(case)
        except (KeyError,ValueError,TypeError,IndexError,OverflowError) as error:
            self._error(error,control)
        self.ring.append((control,row))
        return not self.errors
    def snapshot(self):
        summaries=[]
        for case in self.cases:
            summaries.append({k:v for k,v in case.items() if k not in ('rows',)})
        return dict(schema='readonly_landing_event_cpu_journal_v1',completed_control_rows_seen=self.last_control,num_envs=self.n,pre_control_limit=self.pre,post_control_limit=self.post,case_cap=self.cap,selection='First landing-positive completed control/environment records, chronological then ascending env id; cap explicit, original lifetime counts remain uncapped',landing_positive_records_seen=self.landing_records_seen,original_landing_counter_delta_seen=self.landing_delta_seen,cases_started=len(self.cases),skipped_by_case_cap=self.skipped_cap,diagnostic_valid=not self.errors,errors=list(self.errors),write_errors=list(self.write_errors),cases=summaries,only_existing_copied_CPU_rows_no_new_GPU_actor_physics_or_RNG=True,not_full_callback_replay_frozen_policy_or_success_graduation=True)
    def save(self,folder):
        folder=Path(folder)
        try:
            for case in self.cases:
                last=case['controls'][-1]
                if case['versions'] and case['versions'][-1]['last_control']==last:continue
                p=folder/('landing_event_case_'+str(case['case_id']).zfill(4)+'_through_'+str(last)+'.npz');tmp=p.with_suffix('.npz.partial')
                arrays={name:np.stack([row[name] for row in case['rows']]) for name in self.FIELDS};arrays['recorded_control_no']=np.asarray(case['controls'],dtype=np.int64)
                with tmp.open('xb') as f:np.savez_compressed(f,**arrays)
                tmp.replace(p);digest=hashlib.sha256()
                with p.open('rb') as f:
                    for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):digest.update(chunk)
                case['versions'].append(dict(path=str(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size,SHA=digest.hexdigest(),last_control=last,recorded_frames=len(case['rows']),closed_reason_at_publish=case['closed_reason']))
            p=folder/'CONTROL_LANDING_EVENT_JOURNAL_ACTUAL.json';tmp=p.with_suffix('.json.partial');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(self.snapshot(),indent=2),encoding='utf8');os.replace(tmp,p);return True
        except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError,KeyError) as error:
            if len(self.write_errors)<16:self.write_errors.append(dict(type=type(error).__name__,message=str(error),control=self.last_control))
            return False

"""UNINSTALLED proposal; requires explicit human approval before new-root use.

Only future control-prefix NPZ / matching pre-update PT retention changes.
No environment, policy, optimizer, RNG, physics, reward, or health access.

from pathlib import Path
import functools,hashlib,json,re,time,traceback

POLICY='future_first1_latest2_complete_pairs_plus_incomplete_and_current_failure_v1'
def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda:f.read(8*1024**2),b''):h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()
def put(path,value):
    path=Path(path);tmp=path.with_name(path.name+'.partial')
    with tmp.open('w',encoding='utf8') as f:json.dump(value,f,indent=2)
    tmp.replace(path)
def member(folder,row,source=False):
    p=Path(row['path'])
    pattern=r'preupdate_fullsource_\d+\.pt' if source else r'control_prefix_\d+\.npz'
    if not re.fullmatch(pattern,p.name) or p.is_symlink() or p.resolve().parent!=folder:
        raise RuntimeError('Retention target is not its exact own prefix filename')
    return p
def apply_retention(folder,index):
    folder=Path(folder).resolve();ledger=folder/'PREFIX_PAIR_RETENTION_HISTORY_ACTUAL.json'
    history=json.loads(ledger.read_bytes()).get('transactions',[]) if ledger.exists() else []
    done={x['path'] for txn in history for x in txn['removed']}
    protected=set(range(min(1,len(index))))|set(range(max(0,len(index)-2),len(index)))
    protected|={i for i,row in enumerate(index) if row['controls']<24}
    failed=(folder/'ACTUAL_STEP_ORIGINAL_ERROR.json').exists()
    selected=[]
    try:
        if not failed:
            # Validate the entire proposed batch before removing any pair.
            for i,row in enumerate(index):
                if i in protected:continue
                pair=[]
                for source,r in ((False,row),(True,row['preupdate_source'])):
                    p=member(folder,r,source)
                    if str(p) in done:continue
                    if not p.is_file():raise RuntimeError('Unrecorded missing retention candidate')
                    st=p.stat()
                    if st.st_nlink!=1 or st.st_size!=r['bytes'] or sha(p)!=r['SHA']:
                        raise RuntimeError('Retention candidate identity/bytes/SHA mismatch')
                    pair.append(dict(path=str(p),bytes=st.st_size,SHA=r['SHA'],inode=st.st_ino,mtime_ns=st.st_mtime_ns))
                if pair:selected.append(dict(index=i,files=pair))
            if selected:
                token=str(time.time_ns());intent=folder/('PREFIX_PAIR_RETENTION_INTENT_'+token+'.json')
                plan=dict(epoch=time.time(),policy=POLICY,protected_indices=sorted(protected),selected=selected,only_this_future_own_trace=True)
                # The intent is immutable evidence, including any partial IO failure.
                with intent.open('x',encoding='utf8') as f:json.dump(plan,f,indent=2)
                removed=[]
                for pair in selected:
                    for r in pair['files']:
                        p=Path(r['path']);st=p.stat()
                        if p.is_symlink() or st.st_ino!=r['inode'] or st.st_mtime_ns!=r['mtime_ns'] or st.st_size!=r['bytes'] or st.st_nlink!=1:
                            raise RuntimeError('Retention candidate changed after intent')
                        p.unlink();removed.append(r)
                txn=dict(epoch=time.time(),intent=str(intent),removed=removed,all_selected_actual_removed=True)
                receipt=folder/('PREFIX_PAIR_RETENTION_RECEIPT_'+token+'.json')
                with receipt.open('x',encoding='utf8') as f:json.dump(txn,f,indent=2)
                history.append(txn);put(ledger,dict(policy=POLICY,transactions=history))
    except BaseException:
        path=folder/('PREFIX_PAIR_RETENTION_ORIGINAL_ERROR_'+str(time.time_ns())+'.json')
        with path.open('x',encoding='utf8') as f:json.dump(dict(epoch=time.time(),error=traceback.format_exc(),policy=POLICY,no_claim_partial_removal_complete=True,original_trace_error_path_preserves_all_remaining_files=True),f,indent=2)
        raise
    # Preserve every original producer path, bytes and SHA; add truthful status.
    path=folder/'CONTROL_VALID_PREFIX_INDEX_ACTUAL.json'
    report=json.loads(path.read_bytes());status=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(index):
        raw=member(folder,row);source=member(folder,row['preupdate_source'],True)
        status.append(dict(index=i,path=str(raw),raw_retained=raw.is_file(),preupdate_path=str(source),preupdate_retained=source.is_file(),protected=i in protected))
    report['all_success_and_failed_control_prefixes_retained']=all(x['raw_retained'] and x['preupdate_retained'] for x in status)
    report['approved_future_retention_policy']=POLICY
    report['retention_status']=status
    report['retention_failure_flag_preserves_all_currently_present_files']=failed
    report['older_pruned_prefixes_not_recoverable_on_later_failure']=True
    report['retention_history']=str(ledger) if ledger.exists() else None
    put(path,report)
    return dict(policy=POLICY,prefixes=len(index),retained_complete_pairs=sum(x['raw_retained'] and x['preupdate_retained'] for x in status),current_failure_flag=failed)
def wrap_trace_persist(original):
    @functools.wraps(original)
    def persist(self):
        result=original(self)
        apply_retention(self.folder,self.index)
        return result
    return persist

def exact(a,b):
    if torch.is_tensor(a):return torch.is_tensor(b) and a.dtype==b.dtype and a.shape==b.shape and torch.equal(a.cpu(),b.cpu())
    if isinstance(a,dict):return isinstance(b,dict) and set(a)==set(b) and all(exact(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
    if isinstance(a,(list,tuple)):return isinstance(b,type(a)) and len(a)==len(b) and all(exact(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    return type(a)==type(b) and a==b

def validate_source(ck,n):
    assert n==20000 and all(k in ck for k in RETAINED_GROUPS)

    assert len(ck['optimizer_state_dict']['state'])==17
    assert {int(v['step']) for v in ck['optimizer_state_dict']['state'].values()}=={674740}
    for name in ('sensor_DR_state','feedback_delay_state','physical_action_delay_state','spring_pressure_state','gas_damping_state'):assert ck[name]['n']==n
    for name in ('COM','PD'):assert ck['chassis_PD_state'][name]['num_envs']==n
    def finite(v):
        if torch.is_tensor(v):assert torch.isfinite(v).all()
        elif isinstance(v,dict):
            for x in v.values():finite(x)
        elif isinstance(v,(list,tuple)):
            for x in v:finite(x)
    finite(ck)

"""Reward-only shaping for the human-authorized 270mm step task.

No action, command, physics, termination, success contract, RNG or optimizer
writes. The new cost reads only the already delayed leg target. Callback transport uses measured collider motion, not a ballistic
prediction or a root/COM proxy for wheel clearance. Constants are reward scales,
not new qualification, health or success thresholds.
"""
import torch

RECIPE = dict(version='step270_sampled_leg_excess_v8_reward_only',
    approach_event_scale=4., clearance_transport_event_scale=8.,
    forward_takeoff_event_scale=.25, actual_edge_event_scale=6.,
    actual_landing_event_scale=8., actual_stable_recovery_event_scale=16.,
    requested_forward_rate_weight=3., air_zero_torque_weight=.5,
    leg_tuck_weight=1.7, wheel_below_base_weight=.5,
    airborne_leg_target_overdrive_weight=-.05,
    clearance_target_m=.270, existing_forward_command_m_s=.8,
    path_start_x_m=-.10, path_target_x_m=.60,
    strict_goal_and_command_publisher_unchanged=True,
    signed_reverse_rate=True, measured_clearance_carry_gain=2.,
    clearance_carry_start_front_x_m=0., clearance_carry_full_front_x_m=.35,
    takeoff_gate_start_front_x_m=.10, takeoff_gate_full_front_x_m=.25,
    sampled_leg_action_excess_weight=-.001,
    keep_forward_reward_during_measured_flight_after_request=True)


def path_increment(*, previous_front, current_front, wheel_bottom, origin_x,
                   active, airborne, launched, clean_upright, vx,
                   takeoff, edge_event, landing, recovery, previous_joint_potential=None):
    """Control-independent callback contribution; no positive-only delta.

    Signed, bounded potential differences prevent repeated back/forth farming.
    The joint potential is zero when the wheels are still far from the step;
    holding a high vertical jump stationary earns zero potential increment.
    Vertical progress far from the edge no longer receives the old event reward. Actual edge,
    landing and stable-recovery events retain their strict original witnesses.
    """
    start=RECIPE['path_start_x_m']; end=RECIPE['path_target_x_m']
    previous=previous_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
    current=current_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
    initialized=(previous_front > -1.e5).all(-1)
    delta=((current.clamp(start,end)-previous.clamp(start,end))/(end-start))
    gate=active & clean_upright & initialized
    approach=gate.to(vx.dtype)*delta*RECIPE['approach_event_scale']
    clearance=(wheel_bottom.amin(-1)/RECIPE['clearance_target_m']).clamp(0.,1.)
    joint=((current-.10)/.25).clamp(0.,1.)*clearance.square()
    old_joint=joint if previous_joint_potential is None else previous_joint_potential
    transport=gate.to(vx.dtype)*(joint-old_joint)*RECIPE['clearance_transport_event_scale']
    takeoff_value=takeoff.to(vx.dtype)*(vx/RECIPE['existing_forward_command_m_s']).clamp(0.,1.)*RECIPE['forward_takeoff_event_scale']
    events=(takeoff_value+edge_event.to(vx.dtype)*RECIPE['actual_edge_event_scale']
            +landing.to(vx.dtype)*RECIPE['actual_landing_event_scale']
            +recovery.to(vx.dtype)*RECIPE['actual_stable_recovery_event_scale'])
    return dict(approach=approach,clearance_transport=transport,strict_events=events,
                total=approach+transport+events,next_joint_potential=joint)


def requested_forward_rate(*, request, attempt, landed, vx, vy, roll, pitch,
                           airborne=None, wheel_bottom=None, wheel_front=None,
                           origin_x=None):
    # Measured wheel clearance and forward motion must coincide. No command,
    # force, action, success flag or physics state is written here.
    airborne=torch.zeros_like(request) if airborne is None else airborne
    active=(request | airborne) & attempt & ~landed
    alignment=torch.exp(-(vy/.3).square()-(roll/.3).square()-(pitch/.3).square())
    quality=torch.ones_like(vx)
    if wheel_bottom is not None and wheel_front is not None and origin_x is not None:
        front=wheel_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
        near=((front-RECIPE['clearance_carry_start_front_x_m']) /
              (RECIPE['clearance_carry_full_front_x_m']-RECIPE['clearance_carry_start_front_x_m'])).clamp(0.,1.)
        clearance=(wheel_bottom.amin(-1)/RECIPE['clearance_target_m']).clamp(0.,1.)
        quality=quality+RECIPE['measured_clearance_carry_gain']*near*clearance.square()
    return active.to(vx.dtype)*(vx/RECIPE['existing_forward_command_m_s']).clamp(-1.,1.)*alignment*quality


def forward_takeoff_factor(*, wheel_front, origin_x, vx):
    front=wheel_front.amin(-1)-origin_x
    near=((front-RECIPE['takeoff_gate_start_front_x_m']) /
          (RECIPE['takeoff_gate_full_front_x_m']-RECIPE['takeoff_gate_start_front_x_m'])).clamp(0.,1.)
    return near*(vx/RECIPE['existing_forward_command_m_s']).clamp(0.,1.)


def forward_takeoff_rate(env,original_func,original_params):
    from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
    value=original_func(env,**original_params)
    root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_state_w)
    return value*forward_takeoff_factor(wheel_front=env.h1_phase.previous_front,
        origin_x=env.scene.env_origins[:,0],vx=root[:,7])


def measured_rate(env,name):
    p=env.h1_phase
    if name=='path_progress':return p.progress_control/float(env.step_dt)
    if name=='requested_forward':
        from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
        root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_state_w)
        x,y,z,w=root[:,3:7].unbind(-1)
        roll=torch.atan2(2*(w*x+y*z),1-2*(x*x+y*y))
        pitch=torch.asin((2*(w*y-z*x)).clamp(-1.,1.))
        return requested_forward_rate(request=p.request_for_action,attempt=p.attempt,
            landed=p.landed,vx=root[:,7],vy=root[:,8],roll=roll,pitch=pitch,
            airborne=p.air_ticks>0,wheel_front=p.previous_front,
            wheel_bottom=p.last_measured['step_wheel_min'][:,:,2] if 'step_wheel_min' in p.last_measured else None,
            origin_x=env.scene.env_origins[:,0])
    raise ValueError(name)


def sagittal_leg_lengths(*, delta_world, root_quaternion_xyzw):
    """Actual chassis-frame XZ extension, excluding fixed mounting width.

    Quaternion is the existing measured root orientation. No guessed lateral
    offset, target pose, joint command or actor-visible signal is introduced.
    """
    q=root_quaternion_xyzw[:,None,:3]
    qw=root_quaternion_xyzw[:,None,3:4]
    # Inverse rotate measured vectors: q^-1 v q, for source unit xyzw q.
    t=2.*torch.cross(q.expand_as(delta_world),delta_world,dim=-1)
    local=delta_world-qw*t+torch.cross(q.expand_as(delta_world),t,dim=-1)
    return local[:,:,(0,2)].norm(dim=-1)


def airborne_tuck_rate(env):
    from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
    p=env.h1_phase;r=env.scene['robot'];data=r.data
    root=tensor(data.root_state_w)
    ids=[r.body_names.index(x) for x in ('left_wheel','right_wheel')]
    delta=tensor(data.body_pos_w)[:,ids]-root[:,None,:3]
    current_clear=(p.last_measured['step_wheel_min'][:,:,2]>.005).all(-1)
    active=p.attempt & (p.air_ticks>0) & current_clear & ~p.landed & ~p.crossed.all(-1)
    # .22m is the measured sagittal extension target. MOD4's fixed
    # .2188m lateral wheel mounting distance is excluded from leg extension.
    # Existing phase mask, target scalar, gain and weight are retained.
    length=sagittal_leg_lengths(delta_world=delta,root_quaternion_xyzw=root[:,3:7])
    compact=torch.exp(-torch.sum(torch.abs(length-.22),dim=1)*4.)
    return active.to(root.dtype)*compact



def infeasible_leg_target_cost(*, raw_actions, scale, offset, lower, upper, diff_min, diff_max):
    # A reward reference only. Never replace or edit the applied action.
    # The measured delayed action term retains the original scale/default offset.
    target=raw_actions*scale+offset
    feasible=torch.maximum(torch.minimum(target,upper),lower)
    cranks=[]
    for crank,hip in ((0,1),(2,3)):
        lo=torch.maximum(lower[crank],feasible[:,hip]+diff_min)
        hi=torch.minimum(upper[crank],feasible[:,hip]+diff_max)
        cranks.append(torch.maximum(torch.minimum(feasible[:,crank],hi),lo))
    feasible=torch.stack((cranks[0],feasible[:,1],cranks[1],feasible[:,3]),dim=-1)
    return ((target-feasible)/scale).square().mean(-1)


def airborne_leg_target_overdrive_rate(env):
    from h1_takeoff_progress_environment_v2 import tensor
    from mod4_task import CONTRACT, LEG_ORDER
    p=env.h1_phase
    term=env.action_manager.get_term('legs')
    if tuple(term._joint_names)!=tuple(LEG_ORDER):
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected leg action order')
    raw=tensor(term.raw_actions)
    lower=raw.new_tensor([CONTRACT['joints'][n]['limits_si'][0] for n in LEG_ORDER])
    upper=raw.new_tensor([CONTRACT['joints'][n]['limits_si'][1] for n in LEG_ORDER])
    # raw_actions is AFTER the original delay line; _offset is the actual
    # default pose captured by the installed SDK JointPositionAction.
    cost=infeasible_leg_target_cost(raw_actions=raw,scale=term._scale,offset=term._offset,
        lower=lower,upper=upper,diff_min=term.diff_min,diff_max=term.diff_max)
    current_clear=(p.last_measured['step_wheel_min'][:,:,2]>.005).all(-1)
    active=p.attempt & (p.air_ticks>0) & current_clear & ~p.landed & ~p.crossed.all(-1)
    return active.to(raw.dtype)*cost


def policy_sampled_leg_excess_cost(raw):
    # Original policy action units. Never edit the sampled or executed action.
    if raw.ndim!=2 or raw.shape[1]!=6 or not torch.isfinite(raw).all():
        raise RuntimeError('Expected finite original six-action policy sample')
    return (raw[:,:4].abs()-6.).clamp_min(0.).square().mean(-1)

def sampled_leg_action_excess_rate(env):
    # Initial source/SDK probes are outside an actor control step.
    if not (getattr(env,'h1_stepping',False) and getattr(env,'_h1_sampled_excess_training_active',False)):
        return torch.zeros(env.num_envs,device=env.device)
    raw=getattr(env,'_h1_sampled_actions_for_reward',None)
    if raw is None or raw.shape[0]!=env.num_envs:
        raise RuntimeError('Missing current policy sample during H1 control reward')
    return policy_sampled_leg_excess_cost(raw)


def configure(cfg):
    from isaaclab.managers import RewardTermCfg
    # Keep original event/height progress in diagnostics and checkpoint state;
    # replace only its contribution to the scalar learning reward.
    cfg.rewards.h1_control_events.weight=0.
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_air_wheel_zero_torque.weight=RECIPE['air_zero_torque_weight']
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_leg_tuck.weight=RECIPE['leg_tuck_weight']
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_leg_tuck.func=airborne_tuck_rate
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_leg_tuck.params={}
    cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_wheel_below_base.weight=RECIPE['wheel_below_base_weight']
    for name,weight in [('path_progress',1.),('requested_forward',RECIPE['requested_forward_rate_weight'])]:
        setattr(cfg.rewards,'h1_step270_'+name,RewardTermCfg(func=measured_rate,weight=weight,params={'name':name}))
    push=cfg.rewards.h1_scut_fudan_push_vz
    push.params=dict(original_func=push.func,original_params=dict(push.params));push.func=forward_takeoff_rate
    cfg.rewards.h1_step270_airborne_leg_target_overdrive=RewardTermCfg(
        func=airborne_leg_target_overdrive_rate,weight=RECIPE['airborne_leg_target_overdrive_weight'],params={})
    cfg.rewards.h1_step270_sampled_leg_action_excess=RewardTermCfg(func=sampled_leg_action_excess_rate,weight=RECIPE['sampled_leg_action_excess_weight'],params={})
    cfg._h1_step270_path_reward_recipe=dict(RECIPE)
    return cfg

def out_of_authored_floor(env):
    # Ordinary episode boundary: the complete wheels must remain over authored floor.
    root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_pos_w)
    if not torch.isfinite(root).all():raise RuntimeError('Nonfinite root position at terrain boundary guard')
    origins=env.scene.env_origins
    lower=origins[:,:2].amin(0)-2.5;upper=origins[:,:2].amax(0)+2.5
    lo,hi=wheel_bounds(env)
    if not torch.isfinite(lo).all() or not torch.isfinite(hi).all():raise RuntimeError('Nonfinite wheel footprint at terrain boundary guard')
    return ((root[:,:2]<lower)|(root[:,:2]>upper)).any(-1)|((lo[:,:,:2]<lower)|(hi[:,:,:2]>upper)).any(-1).any(-1)

def save_bad_terrain_query(env,points,q,kind):
    from pathlib import Path
    finite=torch.isfinite(q['height'])&torch.isfinite(q['normal']).all(-1)
    valid=q['hit']&finite
    if kind=='root_ground':valid&=q['normal'][...,2]>0
    bad=torch.nonzero(~valid,as_tuple=False)
    def finite_list(value):
        def clean(x):
            if isinstance(x,list):return [clean(v) for v in x]
            return x if not isinstance(x,float) or np.isfinite(x) else None
        return clean(value.detach().cpu().tolist())
    rows=[]
    for env_id,ray_id in bad.detach().cpu().tolist():
        rows.append(dict(env=env_id,ray=ray_id,actual_start=finite_list(points[env_id,ray_id]),hit=bool(q['hit'][env_id,ray_id]),height=finite_list(q['height'][env_id,ray_id]),normal=finite_list(q['normal'][env_id,ray_id]),distance=finite_list(q['distance'][env_id,ray_id]),face_id=int(q['face_id'][env_id,ray_id])))
    bounds=[finite_list(env.scene.env_origins[:,:2].amin(0)-2.5),finite_list(env.scene.env_origins[:,:2].amax(0)+2.5)]
    out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'job0/production';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    import time
    path=out/('ACTUAL_BAD_TERRAIN_QUERY_'+str(time.time_ns())+'.json')
    with path.open('x',encoding='utf8') as f:json.dump(dict(kind=kind,actual_bad_rows=rows,actual_floor_xy_bounds=bounds,no_fallback_or_tolerance_change=True),f,indent=2,allow_nan=False)

def wheel_bounds(env):
    robot=env.scene['robot'];pos=tensor(robot.data.body_pos_w);quat=tensor(robot.data.body_quat_w);lows=[];highs=[]
    for indices in env.h1_wheel_shapes:
        low=[];high=[]
        for si in indices:
            s=env.h1_shapes[si];q=quat[:,s['body_index']];x,y,z,w=q.unbind(-1)
            R=torch.stack((torch.stack((1-2*(y*y+z*z),2*(x*y-w*z),2*(x*z+w*y)),-1),torch.stack((2*(x*y+w*z),1-2*(x*x+z*z),2*(y*z-w*x)),-1),torch.stack((2*(x*z-w*y),2*(y*z+w*x),1-2*(x*x+y*y)),-1)),-2)

            elif s['type']=='Cube':extent=row.abs().sum(-1)*s['size']*.5;a=center-extent;b=center+extent
            elif s['type']=='Mesh':

            else:raise ValueError('Unqualified wheel collider '+s['type'])
            low.append(a);high.append(b)
        lows.append(torch.stack(low).amin(0));highs.append(torch.stack(high).amax(0))

def step_rate(env,name):
    p=getattr(env,'h1_phase',None)
    if not isinstance(p,Step270Phase):return torch.zeros(env.num_envs,device=env.device)
    root=tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_state_w)
    if name=='release_shortfall':return (p.request_for_action&p.attempt&~p.launched).float()*(p.release_reference_vz-root[:,9]).clamp_min(0)
    if name=='landing_yaw_rate':return p.landed.float()*tensor(env.scene['robot'].data.root_ang_vel_b)[:,2].square()
    if name=='landing_planar_stop':return p.landed.float()*root[:,7:9].square().sum(-1)
    raise ValueError(name)

    configure_path_reward(cfg)
    task.ground_height=ground_height
    return configure_scene(cfg)

"""Frozen SDK audit: independently overlap real solver force samples with time bins."""
import numpy as np
import torch
import warp as wp

class ContactBinOracle:
    def __init__(self,env):
        self.env=env;self.capture=env._integrated_contact;n=env.num_envs
        assert env.physics_dt==.001 and env.step_dt==.01 and n==10
        self.partial=np.zeros((n,2,3));self.history=np.zeros((n,3,2,3));self.control=np.zeros((n,2))
        self.max_history_error_N=0.;self.max_control_impulse_error_N_s=0.;self.calls=0;self.resets=0;self.last_bin=None
        assert self.capture.tick%10==0 and not bool(self.capture.history.any())
        old=self.capture.capture
        def capture(dt):
            old(dt)
            raw=wp.to_torch(self.capture.sensor.contact_view.get_net_contact_forces(dt=dt)).reshape(n,2,3).cpu().double().numpy()
            end=self.capture.tick*1000;start=end-1000
            self.control+=np.maximum(raw[...,2],0)*dt
            # Independent intersection with the global grid (does not call fragment planner).
            for index in range(start//5000,(end-1)//5000+1):
                overlap=max(0,min(end,(index+1)*5000)-max(start,index*5000))
                self.partial+=raw*(overlap/1000000)
                if end>=(index+1)*5000:
                    self.history[:,1:]=self.history[:,:-1].copy();self.history[:,0]=self.partial/.005;self.partial.fill(0)
            actual=self.capture.history.cpu().double().numpy()
            err=float(np.max(np.abs(actual-self.history)));self.max_history_error_N=max(self.max_history_error_N,err)
            impulse=self.capture.impulse.cpu().double().numpy();err_i=float(np.max(np.abs(impulse-self.control)))
            self.max_control_impulse_error_N_s=max(self.max_control_impulse_error_N_s,err_i)
            assert err<.001 and err_i<.00001,('Independent impulse oracle mismatch',err,err_i)
            self.calls+=1
        self.capture.capture=capture
        begin=self.capture.begin_control
        def begin_control():begin();self.control.fill(0)
        self.capture.begin_control=begin_control
        reset=self.capture.reset
        def reset_rows(ids):
            keep=torch.ones(n,dtype=torch.bool,device=env.device);keep[ids]=False
            tensors=[self.capture.sums,self.capture.peaks,self.capture.history,self.capture.peak_history,self.capture.impulse,self.capture.loaded,self.capture.off_run,self.capture.off_max]
            before=[t[keep].clone() for t in tensors];tick=self.capture.tick
            reset(ids)
            for t,b in zip(tensors,before):assert not bool(t[ids].any()) and torch.equal(t[keep],b)
            assert self.capture.tick==tick
            ix=ids.cpu().numpy();self.partial[ix]=0;self.history[ix]=0;self.control[ix]=0;self.resets+=1
        self.capture.reset=reset_rows
    def report(self):
        return dict(actual_physics_callbacks=self.calls,selected_reset_events=self.resets,
                    independent_force_history_max_error_N=self.max_history_error_N,
                    independent_control_impulse_max_error_N_s=self.max_control_impulse_error_N_s,
                    reference='float64 overlap against absolute integer-time5ms grid; real solver-step average force samples',
                    solver_step_force_assumption='piecewise constant; no measured within-step contact time',
                    selected_reset_no_other_rows_changed=True,global_clock_not_reset=True)

        def reset_rows(ids):

            tensors=[self.capture.sums,self.capture.peaks,self.capture.history,self.capture.peak_history,self.capture.impulse,self.capture.loaded,self.capture.off_run,self.capture.off_max]

            assert self.capture.tick==tick

"""Approved S1A A1 auxiliary-detached / A2 joint-PPO candidates; no privileged actor path."""
from copy import deepcopy
import torch
from torch import nn
from rsl_rl.models import MLPModel
from rsl_rl.algorithms import PPO
from history_latent_component import VelocityEncoder,actor_input,supervised_velocity_loss

def masked_velocity_loss(history,encoder,label,valid):
    if valid.shape!=(history.shape[0],1) or not bool(((valid==0)|(valid==1)).all()):
        raise ValueError('Explicit per-sample reset validity required')
    selected=valid[:,0].bool()
    if not bool(selected.any()):return None
    return supervised_velocity_loss(history[selected],encoder,label[selected])

class HistoryActor(MLPModel):
    def __init__(self,*args,variant='A1',encoder_seed=20261007,**kwargs):
        if variant not in ('A1','A2'):raise ValueError('Explicit approved architecture variant required')
        self.variant=variant
        super().__init__(*args,**kwargs)
        self.encoder=VelocityEncoder(seed=encoder_seed)
        if self.obs_normalization:raise ValueError('Baseline observation scaling retained; no new normalizer')

    def _get_obs_dim(self,obs,groups,obs_set):
        if obs_set!='actor' or groups['actor']!=['policy','feedback_history']:
            raise ValueError('Actor only consumes deployable current35 and history175')
        if obs['policy'].shape[-1]!=35 or obs['feedback_history'].shape[-1]!=175:
            raise ValueError('Actual35/175 feedback required')
        return list(groups['actor']),35

    def _get_latent_dim(self):return 38

    def get_latent(self,obs,masks=None,hidden_state=None):
        return actor_input(obs['policy'],obs['feedback_history'],self.encoder,self.variant)

    def as_jit(self):return HistoryExport(self)

    def as_onnx(self,verbose=False):
        raise NotImplementedError('History-aware ONNX export must be independently verified; prevent parent current-only export')

class HistoryExport(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self,actor):
        super().__init__();self.encoder=deepcopy(actor.encoder.net);self.mlp=deepcopy(actor.mlp)
    def forward(self,policy35:torch.Tensor,feedback_history175:torch.Tensor):
        return self.mlp(torch.cat((policy35,self.encoder(feedback_history175)),dim=-1))

class HistoryPPO(PPO):
    def __init__(self,*args,**kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args,**kwargs)
        if not isinstance(self.actor,HistoryActor):raise TypeError('History-aware actor required')
        self.aux_optimizer=None
        self.aux_updates=0
        self.actual_updates=0
        if self.actor.variant=='A1':
            params=[p for name,p in self.actor.named_parameters() if not name.startswith('encoder.')]+list(self.critic.parameters())
            self.optimizer=type(self.optimizer)(params,**self.optimizer.defaults)
            self.aux_optimizer=torch.optim.Adam(self.actor.encoder.parameters(),lr=1e-4)

    def update(self):
        count=int(self.storage.step)
        if count!=self.storage.num_transitions_per_env:raise ValueError('Complete rollout required')
        # A1 PPO sees a detached latent; encoder has its own velocity-supervision optimizer.
        losses=super().update()
        self.actual_updates+=1
        if self.actor.variant=='A1':
            flat=self.storage.observations.flatten(0,1)
            if flat['body_velocity_label'].shape[-1]!=3:raise ValueError('Actual COM Body velocity label missing')
            total=flat.batch_size[0];mean=0.
            # One auxiliary epoch per actual PPO update; accounted in the same learning segment.
            for lo in range(0,total,max(1,(total+3)//4)):
                batch=flat[lo:lo+max(1,(total+3)//4)]
                loss=masked_velocity_loss(batch['feedback_history'],self.actor.encoder,batch['body_velocity_label'],batch['body_velocity_valid'])
                if loss is None:continue
                self.aux_optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True);loss.backward()
                nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.actor.encoder.parameters(),1.)
                self.aux_optimizer.step();self.aux_updates+=1;mean+=float(loss.detach())*batch.batch_size[0]/total
            losses['aux_velocity_mse']=mean
        return losses

    def save(self):
        state=super().save()
        state['history_architecture']=dict(schema=1,variant=self.actor.variant,actor_feedback=[35,175],actor_head_input=38,
          encoder=[175,128,64,3],teacher_point='root COM',teacher_frame='root link/body',teacher_units='m/s',
          actual_updates=self.actual_updates,aux_updates=self.aux_updates,teacher_is_actor_input=False,
          original_optimizer_restored=False,A2_auxiliary_supervision=False,reset_teacher_mask_required=True)
        state['aux_optimizer_state_dict']=self.aux_optimizer.state_dict() if self.aux_optimizer else None
        state['adaptive_learning_rate']=float(self.learning_rate)
        return state

    def load(self,state,load_cfg=None,strict=True):
        meta=state['history_architecture']
        if meta['variant']!=self.actor.variant or meta['teacher_is_actor_input']:
            raise ValueError('Checkpoint architecture or privileged input contract mismatch')
        result=super().load(state,load_cfg,strict)
        if self.aux_optimizer:
            if state['aux_optimizer_state_dict'] is None:raise ValueError('Missing auxiliary optimizer')
            self.aux_optimizer.load_state_dict(state['aux_optimizer_state_dict'])
        elif state['aux_optimizer_state_dict'] is not None:raise ValueError('A2 cannot restore auxiliary learning')
        self.actual_updates=int(meta['actual_updates']);self.aux_updates=int(meta['aux_updates'])
        self.learning_rate=float(state['adaptive_learning_rate'])
        return result

"""Isolated S1A CPU component; not an Isaac observation adapter or training entry."""
from __future__ import annotations
from copy import deepcopy
import torch
from torch import nn

class FeedbackHistory:
    """Five oldest-to-current deployable35 frames; selected resets never mix episodes."""
    def __init__(self,num_envs,*,device='cpu',dtype=torch.float32):
        if num_envs<=0:raise ValueError('Positive environment count required')
        self.frames=torch.zeros(num_envs,5,35,device=device,dtype=dtype)
        self.pending=torch.ones(num_envs,device=device,dtype=torch.bool)
        self.last_tick=None
        self.advances=0

    def reset_rows(self,ids):
        ids=torch.as_tensor(ids,device=self.frames.device,dtype=torch.long)
        if ids.ndim!=1 or torch.any(ids<0) or torch.any(ids>=self.frames.shape[0]):
            raise ValueError('Invalid selected reset rows')
        self.pending[ids]=True

    def observe(self,current35,tick):
        if current35.shape!=(self.frames.shape[0],35) or current35.dtype!=self.frames.dtype or current35.device!=self.frames.device:
            raise ValueError('History only accepts matching deployable35 feedback')
        if not torch.isfinite(current35).all():raise ValueError('Nonfinite actual feedback')
        if not isinstance(tick,int) or isinstance(tick,bool) or tick<0:
            raise ValueError('Integer common control tick required')
        if self.last_tick is not None and tick not in (self.last_tick,self.last_tick+1):
            raise ValueError('Backward or missing control frame')
        new_tick=self.last_tick is None or tick!=self.last_tick
        if new_tick:
            retained=~self.pending
            self.frames[retained,:-1]=self.frames[retained,1:].clone()
            self.frames[retained,-1]=current35[retained]
            self.advances+=1
        if torch.any(self.pending):
            self.frames[self.pending]=current35[self.pending,None,:].expand(-1,5,-1)
            self.pending.zero_()
        self.last_tick=tick
        # Returned buffers cannot mutate the retained episode state.
        return self.frames.flatten(1).clone()

class VelocityEncoder(nn.Module):
    """175->128->64->3 body-velocity candidate, built with an independent CPU RNG."""
    def __init__(self,seed=20261007):
        super().__init__()
        with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]):
            torch.random.default_generator.manual_seed(seed)
            self.net=nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(175,128),nn.ELU(),nn.Linear(128,64),nn.ELU(),nn.Linear(64,3))
    def forward(self,history175):
        if history175.ndim!=2 or history175.shape[1]!=175:raise ValueError('Five35 frames required')
        return self.net(history175)

def actor_input(current35,history175,encoder,variant):
    if current35.ndim!=2 or current35.shape[1]!=35 or history175.shape!=(current35.shape[0],175):
        raise ValueError('Only current feedback and matching deployable history accepted')
    if variant not in ('A1','A2'):raise ValueError('Explicit A1/A2 required')
    latent=encoder(history175)
    return torch.cat((current35,latent.detach() if variant=='A1' else latent),dim=1)

def supervised_velocity_loss(history175,encoder,body_velocity_m_s):
    # SDK must independently read the actual body frame and COM/link point.
    # This function deliberately has no critic-observation slice convention.
    if body_velocity_m_s.shape!=(history175.shape[0],3) or not torch.isfinite(body_velocity_m_s).all():
        raise ValueError('Actual finite Body velocity3 label required')
    return torch.nn.functional.mse_loss(encoder(history175),body_velocity_m_s.detach())

def expand_actor_state(state):
    """Actual rsl5 actor dictionary: preserve all old columns, std and remaining weights."""
    if 'mlp.0.weight' not in state or state['mlp.0.weight'].shape!=(256,35):
        raise ValueError('Expected actual23509 actor first layer256x35')
    if 'distribution.std_param' not in state or state['distribution.std_param'].shape!=(6,):
        raise ValueError('Actual six-dimensional source std required')
    if any(not torch.isfinite(x).all() for x in state.values()):raise ValueError('Nonfinite source actor')
    out=deepcopy(state);w=state['mlp.0.weight']
    out['mlp.0.weight']=torch.cat((w,torch.zeros(256,3,device=w.device,dtype=w.dtype)),dim=1)
    return out

"""Complete D4 queues/RNG restore before an explicit fresh physical episode."""
import json,os,time,torch
from pathlib import Path
from feedback_delay_checkpoint import exact

def restore_action_before_new_episode(env,ck):
    adapter=env._physics_action_delay;q=adapter.queue
    has='physical_action_delay_state' in ck
    if has:
        assert ck['physical_action_delay_recipe']==env.action_delay_recipe()
        adapter.load_state_dict(ck['physical_action_delay_state'])
        assert exact(adapter.state_dict(),ck['physical_action_delay_state'])
    else:
        assert os.environ.get('RM_ACTION_DELAY_INITIAL_ADMISSION')=='D3_to_D4'
        assert ck['feedback_delay_recipe']['profile']=='control_0_10ms_v1'
        assert ck['sensor_recipe']['profile']=='noise_bias_mild_v1'
    episodes={k:g['episode'].clone() for k,g in q.groups.items()}
    # A fresh scene has its own physics clock. Rebase only after the saved state
    # and both queue RNG streams were verified exactly. The following env.reset
    # clears values and resamples the selected episode once through real terms.
    assert int(env._sim_step_counter)==0
    for g in q.groups.values():g['last_apply_tick'].fill_(-1)
    return has,episodes

def verify_action_new_episode(env,episodes):
    adapter=env._physics_action_delay
    for key,g in adapter.queue.groups.items():
        assert torch.equal(g['episode'],episodes[key]+1)
        assert not bool(g['pending_valid'].any()) and not bool(g['applied_valid'].any())
        assert torch.equal(g['applied'],adapter.neutral(key))
        assert torch.equal(g['pending'],adapter.neutral(key))
        for n in ('issued_tick','due_tick','applied_issue_tick','first_apply_tick','last_submit_tick','last_apply_tick'):
            assert bool((g[n]==-1).all()),n
    assert int(env._sim_step_counter)==0
    return True

def append_action_state(ck,env):
    adapter=env._physics_action_delay;s=adapter.state_dict();adapter.queue.validate_state(s)
    ck['physical_action_delay_state']=s
    ck['physical_action_delay_recipe']=env.action_delay_recipe()
    ck['physical_action_delay_resume_contract']='Exact queue/target/timestamp/RNG restore first, then new physics clock and one real episode reset; no PhysX exact resume.'
    return ck

def install_action_save_contract(runner,env):
    from feedback_delay_checkpoint import install_delay_save_contract
    install_delay_save_contract(runner,env);original=runner.save
    def save(path,*a,**kw):
        original(path,*a,**kw)
        ck=torch.load(path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
        torch.save(append_action_state(ck,env),path)
    runner.save=save

def resume_action_new_episode(runner,env,path,log_dir):
    from feedback_delay_checkpoint import resume_delay_new_episode
    ck=torch.load(path,map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
    has,episodes=restore_action_before_new_episode(env,ck)
    row=resume_delay_new_episode(runner,env,path,log_dir)
    verify_action_new_episode(env,episodes)
    v=dict(epoch=time.time(),pid=os.getpid(),source_sha256=row['source_sha256'],
           predecessor_had_action_queue=has,action_queue_targets_timestamps_both_RNG_restored_exact=has,
           explicitly_new_D4_queue=not has,action_episode_incremented_once=True,
           restored_before_new_scene_clock_rebase=True,stale_targets_cleared=True,
           initial_hold_real_default_leg_q_and_zero_wheels=True,
           complete_D3_sensor_feedback_optimizer_global_named_streams_verified=True,
           new_physical_episode=True,PhysX_exact_resume_claimed=False,
           action_delay_recipe=env.action_delay_recipe())
    Path(log_dir,'ACTION_DELAY_RESUME_STARTUP_VERIFIED.json').write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2))
    return v

"""D4 component: target transitions delayed on actual 2.5ms physics apply ticks.

Values are already processed position/velocity targets. The caller retains the
original scale, offset, coherent four-leg CAD projection and actuator limits.
This module has no Isaac imports and is not a production training entry.
"""
import torch

WIDTHS={'legs':4,'wheels':2}
FIELDS=('lag_steps','episode','pending','pending_valid','issued_tick','due_tick',
        'applied','applied_valid','applied_issue_tick','first_apply_tick',
        'last_submit_tick','last_apply_tick')

class PhysicsActionQueue:
    def __init__(self,n,device,seed,enabled=True,physics_us=2500,control_us=10000):
        assert isinstance(n,int) and n>0 and physics_us==2500 and control_us==10000
        self.n=n;self.device=torch.device(device);self.enabled=bool(enabled)
        self.physics_us=physics_us;self.control_us=control_us;self.groups={};self.rng={}
        for key,width in WIDTHS.items():
            self.rng[key]=torch.Generator(device=self.device).manual_seed(int(seed)+(2100037 if key=='legs' else 3100097))
            vector=lambda:torch.zeros((n,width),device=self.device,dtype=torch.float32)
            integer=lambda value=0:torch.full((n,),value,device=self.device,dtype=torch.long)
            flag=lambda:torch.zeros(n,device=self.device,dtype=torch.bool)
            self.groups[key]=dict(lag_steps=integer(),episode=integer(),pending=vector(),pending_valid=flag(),issued_tick=integer(-1),due_tick=integer(-1),applied=vector(),applied_valid=flag(),applied_issue_tick=integer(-1),first_apply_tick=integer(-1),last_submit_tick=integer(-1),last_apply_tick=integer(-1))

    def _input(self,key,x):
        assert key in WIDTHS and torch.is_tensor(x) and x.shape==(self.n,WIDTHS[key])
        assert x.device==self.device and x.dtype==torch.float32 and bool(torch.isfinite(x).all())

    def _tick(self,tick):
        assert isinstance(tick,int) and not isinstance(tick,bool) and tick>=0
        return tick

    def reset(self,key,ids,neutral,new_scene_clock=False):
        self._input(key,neutral)
        ids=torch.as_tensor(ids,device=self.device,dtype=torch.long)
        assert ids.ndim==1 and len(torch.unique(ids))==len(ids) and bool(((ids>=0)&(ids<self.n)).all())
        if new_scene_clock:assert len(ids)==self.n,'Only a complete new scene can rebase physics timing'
        if not len(ids):return
        g=self.groups[key]
        g['lag_steps'][ids]=torch.randint(0,3,(len(ids),),device=self.device,generator=self.rng[key]) if self.enabled else 0
        g['episode'][ids]+=1
        for field in ('pending','applied'):g[field][ids]=neutral[ids]
        for field in ('pending_valid','applied_valid'):g[field][ids]=False
        for field in ('issued_tick','due_tick','applied_issue_tick','first_apply_tick','last_submit_tick'):g[field][ids]=-1
        if new_scene_clock:g['last_apply_tick'][ids]=-1

    def submit(self,key,x,tick):
        self._input(key,x);tick=self._tick(tick);g=self.groups[key]
        old=g['last_submit_tick'];repeat=old==tick;due=~repeat
        if bool(repeat.any()):assert torch.equal(g['pending'][repeat],x[repeat]),'Different command submitted at same policy decision'
        if bool(due.any()):
            assert bool(((old[due]<0)|((tick-old[due])*self.physics_us==self.control_us)).all()),'Skipped or reversed policy command clock'
            assert bool((g['last_apply_tick'][due]<tick).all()),'Submission occurred after physical application'
            assert not bool(g['pending_valid'][due].any()),'Previous command never reached actuator'
            g['pending'][due]=x[due];g['pending_valid'][due]=True
            g['issued_tick'][due]=tick;g['due_tick'][due]=tick+g['lag_steps'][due]
            g['last_submit_tick'][due]=tick

    def apply(self,key,tick):
        assert key in WIDTHS;tick=self._tick(tick);g=self.groups[key]
        old=g['last_apply_tick'];repeat=old==tick;advance=~repeat
        assert bool(((old[advance]<0)|(old[advance]==tick-1)).all()),'Skipped or reversed physical apply callback'
        select=advance & g['pending_valid'] & (g['due_tick']<=tick)
        if bool(select.any()):
            assert bool((g['due_tick'][select]==tick).all()),'Command first application was late'
            g['applied'][select]=g['pending'][select]
            g['applied_valid'][select]=True;g['applied_issue_tick'][select]=g['issued_tick'][select]
            g['first_apply_tick'][select]=tick;g['pending_valid'][select]=False
        g['last_apply_tick'][advance]=tick
        return g['applied'].clone()

    def receipt(self,key,tick):
        tick=self._tick(tick);g=self.groups[key]
        assert bool((g['last_apply_tick']==tick).all())
        first_latency=torch.where(g['applied_valid'],(g['first_apply_tick']-g['applied_issue_tick'])*self.physics_us,-1)
        sample_age=torch.where(g['applied_valid'],(tick-g['applied_issue_tick'])*self.physics_us,-1)
        return dict(physics_period_us=self.physics_us,control_period_us=self.control_us,requested_delay_us=g['lag_steps'].clone()*self.physics_us,actual_first_transition_delay_us=first_latency,held_command_sample_age_us=sample_age,actual_apply_tick=tick,command_issue_tick=g['applied_issue_tick'].clone(),valid_policy_command=g['applied_valid'].clone(),neutral_reset_hold=~g['applied_valid'],same_group_targets_coherent=True)

    def state_dict(self):
        return dict(version=1,n=self.n,enabled=self.enabled,physics_us=self.physics_us,control_us=self.control_us,rng={k:g.get_state().clone() for k,g in self.rng.items()},groups={k:{f:v.clone() for f,v in g.items()} for k,g in self.groups.items()})

    def validate_state(self,state):
        assert state['version']==1 and state['n']==self.n and state['enabled']==self.enabled and state['physics_us']==2500 and state['control_us']==10000
        assert set(state['groups'])==set(state['rng'])==set(WIDTHS)
        for key,width in WIDTHS.items():
            g=state['groups'][key];assert set(g)==set(FIELDS)
            for field,v in g.items():
                expected=(self.n,width) if field in ('pending','applied') else (self.n,)
                dtype=torch.float32 if len(expected)==2 else torch.bool if field.endswith('_valid') else torch.long
                assert torch.is_tensor(v) and v.shape==expected and v.dtype==dtype and bool(torch.isfinite(v).all()),field
            assert bool(((g['lag_steps']>=0)&(g['lag_steps']<=2)).all()) and bool((g['episode']>=0).all())
            if not self.enabled:assert not bool(g['lag_steps'].any())
            assert all(bool((g[field]>=-1).all()) for field in FIELDS if g[field].dtype==torch.long)
            pending=g['pending_valid'];applied=g['applied_valid']
            assert bool((g['due_tick'][pending]==g['issued_tick'][pending]+g['lag_steps'][pending]).all())
            assert bool((g['issued_tick'][pending]==g['last_submit_tick'][pending]).all())
            assert bool((g['due_tick'][pending]>g['last_apply_tick'][pending]).all())
            latency=g['first_apply_tick'][applied]-g['applied_issue_tick'][applied]
            assert bool(((latency>=0)&(latency<=2)).all()) and bool((g['first_apply_tick'][applied]<=g['last_apply_tick'][applied]).all())
            assert bool((g['applied_issue_tick'][applied]>=0).all())
            generator=torch.Generator(device=self.device);generator.set_state(state['rng'][key].cpu())
        return True

    def load_state_dict(self,state):
        self.validate_state(state)
        self.groups={k:{f:v.to(self.device).clone() for f,v in g.items()} for k,g in state['groups'].items()}
        for key,generator in self.rng.items():generator.set_state(state['rng'][key].cpu())

    def recipe(self):
        return dict(profile='physical_target_0_2500_5000us_v1' if self.enabled else 'off',physics_period_us=2500,control_period_us=10000,actual_transition_delay_us=[0,2500,5000] if self.enabled else [0],sub_ms_exact_timing_claimed=False,leg_four_targets_coherent=True,wheel_two_targets_coherent=True,leg_and_wheel_per_environment_episode_RNG_independent=True,queue_values='Original processed joint-position rad / joint-velocity rad_s targets',original_scale_offset_CAD_guard_and_gain_after_torque_speed_envelope_unchanged=True,reset_initial_target='Caller real default leg q and zero wheel velocity; stale commands cleared',holding_age_is_distinct_from_first_transition_latency=True,engineering_pressure_not_hardware_calibration=True,CPU_component_not_actual_SDK_or_learning=True)

===== END FULL UTF8 SEGMENT =====

"""Isolated D4 SDK adapter: delay processed targets at physical application.

This module patches only action terms of its newly constructed candidate env.
It has no imports of Isaac, no standalone training entry and no host authority.
The original process_actions retains scale/default-offset/CAD projection, and
the original apply_actions retains articulation target and actuator paths.
"""
import torch,types
from action_delay_physics_queue import PhysicsActionQueue,WIDTHS

def as_tensor(value):
    return value.torch if hasattr(value,'torch') else value

class PhysicalActionDelayAdapter:
    def __init__(self,env,enabled,seed,collect=False):
        assert env.physics_dt==.0025 and env.step_dt==.01 and env.cfg.decimation==4
        assert not getattr(env.sim,'_physics_handles_decimation',False)
        self.env=env;self.queue=PhysicsActionQueue(env.num_envs,env.device,seed,enabled=enabled)

        allids=torch.arange(self.env.num_envs,device=self.env.device)

            # the integration interval has not begun yet.

            this._processed_actions=value

            finally:this._processed_actions=original

            error=float((actual-value).abs().max());adapter.formula_max_error=max(adapter.formula_max_error,error)
            assert error<=1e-6,'Actual articulation target differs from selected delayed target'
            adapter.calls[key]+=1
            if adapter.collect:
                row={name:(item.detach().cpu().tolist() if torch.is_tensor(item) else item) for name,item in adapter.queue.receipt(key,tick).items()}
                row.update(requested_processed_target=original.detach().cpu().tolist(),actual_processed_target=value.detach().cpu().tolist(),actual_articulation_target=actual.detach().cpu().tolist())
                adapter.rows[key].append(row)
        def reset(this,env_ids=None):
            original_reset(env_ids)
            selected=adapter.ids(env_ids)
            old=adapter.queue.state_dict() if adapter.collect else None
            adapter.queue.reset(key,selected,adapter.neutral(key))
            if adapter.collect:
                others=torch.ones(adapter.env.num_envs,dtype=torch.bool,device=adapter.env.device);others[selected]=False
                g=adapter.queue.groups[key]
                assert all(torch.equal(g[f][others],old['groups'][key][f][others]) for f in g)
                assert torch.equal(g['last_apply_tick'],old['groups'][key]['last_apply_tick'])
                assert torch.equal(g['applied'][selected],adapter.neutral(key)[selected]) and not bool(g['pending_valid'][selected].any())
                adapter.reset_rows.append(dict(group=key,env_ids=selected.cpu().tolist(),unselected_exact=True,global_physics_clock_preserved=True,selected_stale_pending_cleared=True,neutral_target_from_actual_default_q_or_zero_wheel=True))
        term.process_actions=types.MethodType(process,term);term.apply_actions=types.MethodType(apply,term);term.reset=types.MethodType(reset,term)
        self.queue.reset(key,self.ids(None),self.neutral(key))
    def state_dict(self):return self.queue.state_dict()
    def load_state_dict(self,state):self.queue.load_state_dict(state)
    def audit(self):
        return dict(recipe=self.queue.recipe(),callback_counts=self.calls,application_formula_max_error=self.formula_max_error,rows=self.rows,reset_rows=self.reset_rows,policy_requested_processed_targets_restored_after_apply=True,original_legacy_delay_remains_disabled=True,actual_apply_time_is_before_integration=True,actual_apply_time_counter_minus1=True,not_training_or_full_DR_graduation=True)

"""Torque diagnostics in actuator-local order, independent of policy slot order.

This does not alter the actuator or its applied torque. Mod4DCMotor first applies
the nominal hardware envelope, then episode/step gains, and finally clips again.
The diagnostic compares raw requested PD torque times those gains to final torque.
It therefore includes both envelope clips. Snapshot timing remains 10 ms.
"""


def rating_clipped(actuator, threshold=0.1):
    requested = actuator.computed_effort * actuator.episode_scale * actuator.step_scale
    return (requested - actuator.applied_effort).abs() > threshold

"""Read-only admission to a mild-DR experiment, NOT legacy graduation or sim2real."""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path


def assess(report):
    reasons = []
    if report.get('nonfinite', True) or not report.get('physics_pass'):
        reasons.append('physics/nonfinite')
    if report.get('seconds', 0) < 15 or report.get('mode') != 'deterministic_policy':
        reasons.append('requires deterministic fifteen-second report')
    if report.get('max_closure_after_grace_m', 1) > .002 or report.get('max_mimic_after_grace_rad', 1) > .01:
        reasons.append('closure/mimic')
    pe = report.get('per_environment', {})
    groups = report.get('groups', [])
    passed = []
    constants = set()
    for group_id, group in enumerate(groups):
        ids = [i for i, gid in enumerate(pe.get('group_ids', [])) if gid == group_id]
        cmd = float(group['command_vx'])
        # ±2 m/s extrapolation is diagnostic; this admission only covers trained ±1.5.
        if abs(cmd) > 1.5:
            continue
        if group['profile'] == 'constant':
            constants.add(cmd)
        if len(ids) < 8:
            reasons.append(f'group {group_id}: fewer than eight samples')
            continue
        try:
            accepted = []
            for i in ids:
                accepted.append(bool(pe['alive'][i])
                    and pe['vel_error'][i] <= max(.12, .25 * abs(cmd))
                    and pe['tilt'][i] <= 8 and pe['max_tilt'][i] <= 12
                    and pe['height_error'][i] <= .03
                    and pe['delta'][i] <= .18 and pe['d2'][i] <= .25
                    and pe['guide_force'][i] <= 1 and pe['base_force'][i] <= 1
                    and pe['left_mean_fz_substep'][i] >= 10
                    and pe['right_mean_fz_substep'][i] >= 10
                    and pe['longest_both_low_force_s_substep'][i] <= .01501
                    and max(pe['left_gap_max_control_m'][i], pe['right_gap_max_control_m'][i]) <= .002
                    and max(pe['left_support_slip_control'][i], pe['right_support_slip_control'][i]) <= .15
                    and (group['profile'] != 'ramp_brake_reverse' or pe['stop_abs_speed'][i] <= .12))
            fraction = sum(accepted) / len(accepted)
            passed.append(dict(group_id=group_id, command_vx=cmd, profile=group['profile'],
                               count=len(ids), physical_admission_fraction=fraction))
            if fraction < .8:
                reasons.append(f'group {group_id}: physical admission {fraction:.3f} < .8')
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as error:
            reasons.append(f'group {group_id}: missing physical evidence {error}')
    if not {0., .3, .6, 1., -1.5, 1.5}.issubset(constants):
        reasons.append('missing required trained constant-speed groups')
    return dict(eligible_for_mild_dr_trial=not reasons, reasons=reasons, groups=passed,
                seed=report.get('seed'), checkpoint=report.get('checkpoint'),
                legacy_strict_pass_window=report.get('strict_pass_window'),
                integrated_mean_pass=report.get('strict_pass_integrated_mean'),
                scope='project-specific admission for an isolated DR experiment; not legacy graduation')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('reports', nargs='+', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    outcomes = [assess(json.loads(path.read_text())) for path in args.reports]
    seed_count = len({result['seed'] for result in outcomes if result['eligible_for_mild_dr_trial']})
    result = dict(results=outcomes, two_recent_windows_pass=len(outcomes) >= 2 and
                  all(r['eligible_for_mild_dr_trial'] for r in outcomes[-2:]),
                  distinct_passing_seeds=seed_count,
                  multi_seed_evidence_present=seed_count >= 2,
                  automatic_graduation=False)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))

def identity(pid):
    p=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
    try:
        st=(p/'stat').read_text().rsplit(')',1)[1].split()
        return dict(pid=pid,state=st[0],start_ticks=int(st[19]),cwd=str((p/'cwd').resolve()),
                    argv=[v.decode() for v in (p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if v])
    except (OSError,ValueError):return None


def read_syscall(proc):
    global SUDO_INPUT
    path=proc/'syscall'
    try:return path.read_text()
    except PermissionError:
        # Read only this verified same-account supervisor. Never run the ledger
        # transaction as root: its files must stay writable by the trainer account.
        if SUDO_INPUT is None:
            SUDO_INPUT=sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
            assert SUDO_INPUT,'read-only process inspection authentication unavailable'
        command=['sudo','-S','-p','','cat',str(path)]
        p=subprocess.run(command,input=SUDO_INPUT+'\n',text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=5)
        assert p.returncode==0,'read-only syscall inspection failed'
        return p.stdout

"""Bounded autonomous gates; no simulator imports and no budget authority."""
import math

LEVELS = (3., 4., 5., 6., 8., 10., 4*math.pi)
DR_PROFILES = {
    'white_v1': {'mass': (.95,1.05), 'motor': (.95,1.05), 'friction': (.8,1.)},
    'white_v2': {'mass': (.925,1.075), 'motor': (.925,1.075), 'friction': (.75,1.)},
    'white_v3': {'mass': (.9,1.1), 'motor': (.9,1.1), 'friction': (.7,1.)},
}

def next_action(cap, profile, consecutive, paired, remaining, dr_rejected, rate_rejected=()):
    if cap not in LEVELS or profile not in DR_PROFILES:
        raise ValueError('Unknown curriculum')
    if consecutive < 2 or not paired or remaining < 5400:
        return ('continue', None)
    # Hold yaw fixed during DR changes; never combine the two changes.
    target = 'white_v2' if profile=='white_v1' and cap>=6 else 'white_v3' if profile=='white_v2' and cap>=8 else None
    if target and target not in dr_rejected:
        return ('dr_trial', target)
    index=LEVELS.index(cap)
    if index+1<len(LEVELS) and LEVELS[index+1] in rate_rejected:
        return ('targeted_repair_hold', LEVELS[index+1])
    return ('rate_preflight', LEVELS[index+1]) if index+1<len(LEVELS) else ('continue',None)

def settle_segment(b, pid, ended):
    # Frozen evaluation, reconnect time and a second recovery cannot be charged.
    a=b.get('active_segment')
    if not a or a['pid'] != pid:
        raise ValueError('Missing or different active trainer; reconciliation required')
    if ended < a['accounted_through_epoch']:
        raise ValueError('Invalid training end boundary')
    tail=ended-a['accounted_through_epoch']
    b['charged_training_seconds'] += tail
    a.update(accounted_through_epoch=ended, ended_epoch=ended, end_reason='autonomy_save_boundary_handover')
    b.setdefault('completed_segments',[]).append(a)
    b['active_segment']=None
    b['remaining_training_seconds']=max(0.,b['authorized_training_seconds']-b['charged_training_seconds'])
    return tail

def safety_veto(report):
    """Extra single-sample severe-event guard; retain the original group booleans."""
    per=report.get('per_environment',{})
    peak=per.get('peak_tilt',per.get('max_tilt',[]))
    off=per.get('longest_both_low_s',per.get('longest_both_low_force_s_substep',[]))
    alive=report.get('alive',per.get('alive',[]))
    # Existing flat +/-2 extrapolation remains diagnostic, not a trained group.
    gids=per.get('group_ids')
    if gids and report.get('mode')=='deterministic_policy':
        groups=report['groups']
        ids=[i for i,gid in enumerate(gids) if abs(groups[gid]['command_vx'])<=1.5]
        peak=[peak[i] for i in ids] if peak else []
        off=[off[i] for i in ids] if off else []
        alive=[alive[i] for i in ids] if alive else []
    return (not report.get('nonfinite',False)
            and all(alive)
            and (not peak or max(peak)<=15.)
            and (not off or max(off)<=.02001))

"""Validate explicit additions to the one canonical effective-training budget."""


def validate_budget(budget):
    total = 36000
    seen = set()
    for extension in budget.get('budget_extensions', []):
        identifier = extension['extension_id']
        assert identifier not in seen, 'duplicate budget extension'
        seen.add(identifier)
        assert extension['state'] == 'applied'
        assert extension['authorization_basis'] == 'explicit_user_request'
        seconds = extension['additional_training_seconds']
        assert isinstance(seconds, int) and seconds > 0, 'invalid training-time addition'
        total += seconds
    assert budget['authorized_training_seconds'] == total, 'unregistered budget change'
    assert float(budget.get('charged_training_seconds', 0)) >= 0, 'negative charged time'
    return total

"""Chassis-only body-link COM translation in meters; no simulation dependency."""
import torch
PROFILE='chassis_link_local_independent_xyz_5mm_v1'

class ChassisCOM:
    def __init__(self,num_envs,device,seed,enabled):
        if num_envs<=0:raise ValueError('Positive environment count required')
        self.num_envs=int(num_envs);self.device=torch.device(device);self.enabled=bool(enabled)
        self.delta_m=torch.zeros((num_envs,3),device=self.device)
        self.episode=torch.zeros(num_envs,dtype=torch.long,device=self.device)
        self.generators=[torch.Generator(device=self.device).manual_seed(int(seed)+190009+i*100003) for i in range(3)]
    def reset(self,ids):
        raw=torch.as_tensor(ids,device=self.device)
        if raw.dtype not in (torch.int32,torch.int64) or raw.ndim!=1:raise ValueError('Integer environment index vector required')
        ids=raw.long()
        if not len(ids):return
        if int(ids.min())<0 or int(ids.max())>=self.num_envs or len(torch.unique(ids))!=len(ids):raise ValueError('Invalid selected environment indices')
        self.episode[ids]+=1
        if self.enabled:
            for axis,g in enumerate(self.generators):
                self.delta_m[ids,axis]=torch.empty(len(ids),device=self.device).uniform_(-.005,.005,generator=g)
        else:self.delta_m[ids]=0
    def state_dict(self):
        return dict(version=1,profile=PROFILE,enabled=self.enabled,num_envs=self.num_envs,delta_m=self.delta_m.clone(),
                    episode=self.episode.clone(),private_xyz_RNG=[g.get_state().clone() for g in self.generators])
    def load_state_dict(self,state):
        if state['version']!=1 or state['profile']!=PROFILE or state['enabled']!=self.enabled or state['num_envs']!=self.num_envs:raise ValueError('COM state scope mismatch')
        delta=state['delta_m'].to(self.device);episode=state['episode'].to(self.device)
        if delta.shape!=(self.num_envs,3) or episode.shape!=(self.num_envs,) or episode.dtype!=torch.long:raise ValueError('COM state shape/type mismatch')

"""Isolated D7 chassis COM subgroup; model coefficients and mass/inertia stay untouched."""
import types,torch
