def transform_array(value):
    import warp as wp
    return wp.from_torch(value.contiguous(),dtype=wp.transformf)


def verify_rotation_preserved(before,after):
    # PhysX normalizes supplied orientations in float32. Compare normalized double
    # rotations, with a bound derived solely from source dtype arithmetic precision.
    # Translation, mass/inertia and all task/hardware tolerances remain independent.
    if before.shape!=after.shape or before.dtype!=after.dtype:raise ValueError('Quaternion representation mismatch')
    if not bool(torch.isfinite(before).all()) or not bool(torch.isfinite(after).all()):raise AssertionError('Nonfinite quaternion')
    eps=torch.finfo(before.dtype).eps
    a=before.double();b=after.double();na=a.norm(dim=-1,keepdim=True);nb=b.norm(dim=-1,keepdim=True)
    assert bool(((na-1).abs()<=8*eps).all()) and bool(((nb-1).abs()<=8*eps).all()),'Quaternion must remain unit within dtype roundtrip precision'
    a=a/na;b=b/nb
    dot=(a*b).sum(-1,keepdim=True);b=torch.where(dot<0,-b,b)
    maxdiff=float((a-b).abs().max())
    assert maxdiff<=8*eps,('Actual physical orientation changed',maxdiff,eps)
    return dict(raw_quaternion_bytes_exact=torch.equal(before,after),raw_max_component_delta=float((before-after).abs().max()),
                normalized_double_quaternion_max_component_delta=maxdiff,dtype_epsilon=eps,
                rotation_preserved_within_dtype_roundtrip=True,no_task_or_hardware_tolerance_change=True)

class ChassisCOMSDK:
    def __init__(self,env,enabled,seed):
        self.env=env;self.robot=env.scene['robot'];names=list(self.robot.body_names)
        if names.count('chassis')!=1:raise ValueError('Exactly one actual chassis body required')
        self.body_id=names.index('chassis');self.original_pose=tensor(self.robot.root_view.get_coms()).clone().to(env.device)
        assert torch.equal(tensor(self.robot.data.body_com_pose_b).to(env.device),self.original_pose)
        self.orientation_after_parent_reset=self.original_pose[...,3:].clone()
        self.component=ChassisCOM(env.num_envs,env.device,seed,enabled)
        self.setter_calls=0;self.reset_calls=0;self.cache_invalidations=0;self.orientation_roundtrip_max=0.;self.raw_quaternion_bytes_always_exact=True
        self.install_expected_value_auditor()
        self.reset(torch.arange(env.num_envs,device=env.device))
        original=env._reset_idx;adapter=self
        def reset_idx(this,ids):original(ids);adapter.reset(ids)
        env._reset_idx=types.MethodType(reset_idx,env)
    def expected_full_pose(self):
        value=self.original_pose.clone();value[...,3:]=self.orientation_after_parent_reset
        value[:,self.body_id,:3]+=self.component.delta_m
        return value
    def invalidate_COM_dependent_cache(self):
        # Installed setter writes local pose buffer/PhysX but does not invalidate these derived caches.
        # Global time and physical state do not change; unchanged rows recompute identical values.
        names=('_body_com_pose_w','_root_com_pose_w','_body_link_vel_w','_root_link_vel_w',
               '_root_link_lin_vel_b','_root_link_ang_vel_b')
        for name in names:
            if hasattr(self.robot.data,name):getattr(self.robot.data,name).timestamp=-float('inf')
        self.cache_invalidations+=1
    def apply(self,ids):
        expected=self.expected_full_pose()
        # D0 can change inertia/principal-axis orientation without advancing simulation time.
        # Installed set_coms_index writes partial body data into a cached full-row buffer,
        # then sends that FULL selected-environment row to PhysX. Refresh the read cache
        # first so unrelated current body orientations cannot be overwritten by stale data.
        self.robot.data._body_com_pose_b.timestamp=-float('inf')
        current=tensor(self.robot.root_view.get_coms()).to(expected.device)
        refreshed=tensor(self.robot.data.body_com_pose_b).to(expected.device)
        assert torch.equal(current,refreshed),'Full-row COM buffer must reflect current PhysX before partial write'
        assert torch.equal(current[...,3:],self.orientation_after_parent_reset)
        if self.component.enabled:
            before_orientation=tensor(self.robot.root_view.get_coms()).to(expected.device)[...,3:].clone()
            self.robot.set_coms_index(coms=transform_array(expected[ids][:,[self.body_id],:].contiguous()),
                                      body_ids=[self.body_id],env_ids=ids,full_data=False)
            after=tensor(self.robot.root_view.get_coms()).to(expected.device).clone()
            proof=verify_rotation_preserved(before_orientation,after[...,3:])
            self.orientation_roundtrip_max=max(self.orientation_roundtrip_max,proof['normalized_double_quaternion_max_component_delta'])
            self.raw_quaternion_bytes_always_exact &= proof['raw_quaternion_bytes_exact']
            # Adopt the independently checked actual normalized representation for exact
            # subsequent buffer/backend audit; never adopt an unchecked physical rotation.
            self.orientation_after_parent_reset[ids]=after[ids,...,3:]
            self.robot.data._body_com_pose_b.timestamp=-float('inf')
            assert torch.equal(tensor(self.robot.data.body_com_pose_b).to(expected.device),after)
            self.setter_calls+=1;self.invalidate_COM_dependent_cache()
        self.audit_parameters()
    def reset(self,ids):
        ids=torch.as_tensor(ids,device=self.env.device,dtype=torch.long)
        if not len(ids):return
        # D0 inertia reset may update PhysX principal-axis pose representation.
        # Preserve its CURRENT orientation; never restore a constructor-time principal-axis quaternion.
        current=tensor(self.robot.root_view.get_coms()).to(self.env.device)
        assert torch.equal(current[...,:3][:,[i for i in range(current.shape[1]) if i!=self.body_id]],
                           self.original_pose[...,:3][:,[i for i in range(current.shape[1]) if i!=self.body_id]])
        self.orientation_after_parent_reset[ids]=current[ids,...,3:]
        self.component.reset(ids);self.apply(ids);self.reset_calls+=1
    def audit_parameters(self):
        expected=self.expected_full_pose()
        actual=tensor(self.robot.root_view.get_coms()).to(expected.device)
        buffered=tensor(self.robot.data.body_com_pose_b).to(expected.device)
        assert torch.equal(actual,expected) and torch.equal(buffered,expected)
        assert torch.equal(actual[...,3:],self.orientation_after_parent_reset),'Current D0 principal-axis orientation must stay exact'
        other=[i for i in range(expected.shape[1]) if i!=self.body_id]
        assert torch.equal(actual[:,other,:3],self.original_pose[:,other,:3]),'Other body COM translation must stay exact'
        return actual
    def install_expected_value_auditor(self):
        mild=self.env._mild_dr;original=mild.audit;adapter=self
        def audit(this):
            adapter.audit_parameters();nominal=this.com
            assert torch.equal(nominal.to(adapter.original_pose.device),adapter.original_pose[...,:3])
            this.com=adapter.expected_full_pose()[...,:3].clone()
            try:row=original()
            finally:this.com=nominal
            assert this.com is nominal
            row['D7_actual_chassis_only_COM_expected_audit']=dict(actual_PhysX_buffer_exact=True,
                original_nominal_reference_restored=True,all_other_parameter_checks_tolerances_unchanged=True)
            return row
        mild.audit=types.MethodType(audit,mild)
    def state_dict(self):return self.component.state_dict()
    def load_state_dict(self,state):
        self.component.load_state_dict(state)
        self.orientation_after_parent_reset=tensor(self.robot.root_view.get_coms()).to(self.env.device)[...,3:].clone()
        self.apply(torch.arange(self.env.num_envs,device=self.env.device))
    def audit(self):
        self.audit_parameters();mass=tensor(self.robot.root_view.get_masses()).to(self.env.device)
        fraction=mass[:,self.body_id]/mass.sum(1)
        return dict(profile=PROFILE,enabled=self.component.enabled,chassis_body_index=self.body_id,chassis_body_name='chassis',
                    delta_range_m=[float(self.component.delta_m.min()),float(self.component.delta_m.max())],
                    actual_PhysX_local_pose_and_buffer_exact=True,other_body_physical_rotations_preserved=True,raw_quaternion_bytes_always_exact=self.raw_quaternion_bytes_always_exact,normalized_rotation_roundtrip_max=self.orientation_roundtrip_max,
                    no_mass_inertia_or_PD_parameter_setters=True,COM_frame='body link-local meters; quaternion xyzw retained',
                    chassis_mass_fraction=fraction.cpu().tolist(),whole_robot_COM_delta_is_mass_weighted_not_5mm=True,

"""Read actual D6 scene COM and explicit motor PD; no parameter setter or RNG draw."""
import torch
from gas_damping_sdk_adapter import tensor

def quat_rotate_xyzw(q,v):
    xyz=q[...,:3]; w=q[...,3:4]
    uv=torch.cross(xyz,v,dim=-1)
    return v+2*(w*uv+torch.cross(xyz,uv,dim=-1))

def joint_indices(a,total):
    value=a.joint_indices
    if isinstance(value,slice):return list(range(total))[value]
    if hasattr(value,'torch'):value=value.torch
    if torch.is_tensor(value):return value.detach().cpu().tolist()
    return list(value)

def read_chassis_pd(env):
    cpu=torch.get_rng_state().clone(); cuda=torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all()
    r=env.scene['robot']; names=list(r.body_names); joints=list(r.joint_names)
    assert names.count('chassis')==1
    chassis=names.index('chassis')
    direct=tensor(r.root_view.get_coms()).clone()
    local=tensor(r.data.body_com_pose_b).clone().to(direct.device)
    assert direct.shape==(env.num_envs,len(names),7) and torch.equal(direct,local)
    mass=tensor(r.root_view.get_masses()).clone()
    inertia=tensor(r.root_view.get_inertias()).clone()
    links=tensor(r.data.body_link_pose_w).clone()
    world=tensor(r.data.body_com_pos_w).clone()
    estimated=links[...,:3].double()+quat_rotate_xyzw(links[...,3:7].double(),local[...,:3].to(links.device).double())
    frame_error=float((estimated-world.double()).abs().max())
    assert frame_error<1e-5,frame_error
    assert bool((mass>0).all()) and bool(torch.isfinite(inertia).all())
    weighted=(world.double()*mass.to(world.device).double()[...,None]).sum(1)/mass.to(world.device).double().sum(1)[:,None]
    drive_k=tensor(r.root_view.get_dof_stiffnesses()).clone()
    drive_d=tensor(r.root_view.get_dof_dampings()).clone()
    pd={}
    for name,width,kp,kd in (('legs',4,60.,2.),('wheels',2,0.,.6)):
        a=r.actuators[name]; ids=joint_indices(a,len(joints)); assert len(ids)==width
        k=tensor(a.stiffness).clone(); d=tensor(a.damping).clone()
        assert bool((k==kp).all()) and bool((d==kd).all()),(name,k,d)
        assert bool((drive_k[:,ids]==0).all()) and bool((drive_d[:,ids]==0).all()),name
        pd[name]=dict(joint_indices=ids,joint_names=[joints[i] for i in ids],
                      explicit_model_stiffness=k.cpu().tolist(),explicit_model_damping=d.cpu().tolist(),
                      PhysX_implicit_drive_stiffness=drive_k[:,ids].cpu().tolist(),
                      PhysX_implicit_drive_damping=drive_d[:,ids].cpu().tolist())
    assert torch.equal(cpu,torch.get_rng_state()) and all(torch.equal(a,b) for a,b in zip(cuda,torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all()))
    static=dict(body_names=names,chassis_index=chassis,chassis_name=names[chassis],
                local_COM_pose_xyz_xyzw=local.cpu().tolist(),mass_kg=mass.cpu().tolist(),inertia_kg_m2=inertia.cpu().tolist(),
                explicit_PD=pd,body_count=len(names),joint_names=joints)
    return dict(static=static,actual_PhysX_and_buffer_local_COM_exact=True,COM_frame='each body link-local meters, quaternion xyzw',
                independent_link_to_world_COM_formula_max_error_m=frame_error,

"""Separate ordinary RL episode resets from solver/data integrity failures.

The underlying task still resets the exact same environments at the exact same
thresholds. Only the global full-save stop policy is changed by human authorization.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import math
import json,os,time
import torch

ORDINARY_TERMS=frozenset(('bad_orientation','base_contact','low_base','closure','h1_step270_arena_exit'))
INTEGRITY_TERMS=frozenset(('mimic',))

def learning_health_pass(v):
    return (v.get('version')==3 and v.get('integrity_task_reset_events')==0
        and v.get('unknown_task_reset_events')==0 and v.get('nonfinite_observed') is False
        and math.isfinite(v.get('max_closure_error_m',float('nan')))
        and v.get('max_mimic_error_rad',float('inf'))<=.01
        and v.get('actual_physics_callbacks')==v.get('expected_physics_callbacks')
        and v.get('termination_reason_coverage_exact') is True)

class ClockTrainingHealth:
    def __init__(self,env,folder):
        self.env=env;self.folder=Path(folder)
        self.counts=torch.zeros(env.num_envs,dtype=torch.int64,device=env.device)
        self.reason_counts={n:torch.zeros_like(self.counts) for n in env.termination_manager.active_terms}
        self.integrity_counts=torch.zeros_like(self.counts);self.ordinary_counts=torch.zeros_like(self.counts)
        self.unknown_counts=torch.zeros_like(self.counts)
        self.steps=0;self.initial_tick=env._integrated_contact.tick;self.reason=None
        self.nonfinite=False;self.coverage_exact=True;self.last_events=[];self.last_event_count=0
        self.names=tuple(self.reason_counts)
        assert {'closure','mimic'}.issubset(self.names),'Missing actual closure/mimic task terms'
        old=env.step
        def step(action):
            result=old(action);self.steps+=1
            tm=env.termination_manager;actual=tm.terminated.to(torch.bool)
            masks={n:tm.get_term(n).to(torch.bool) for n in self.names}
            ordinary=torch.zeros_like(actual);integrity=torch.zeros_like(actual);unknown=torch.zeros_like(actual)
            for n,m in masks.items():
                self.reason_counts[n].add_(m.to(torch.int64))
                if n in ORDINARY_TERMS:ordinary|=m
                elif n in INTEGRITY_TERMS:integrity|=m
                elif n!='time_out':unknown|=m
            accounted=ordinary|integrity|unknown

"""GPU contact impulse accumulation; never modifies forces or sensor data.

Physical substep dt=.5ms, force mean in fixed5ms bins, three-bin history.
Only the mean-force history may gate reward. Peak force is diagnostic only.
"""
import torch
import warp as wp


@wp.kernel
def capture_kernel(raw: wp.array(dtype=wp.vec3),
                   sums: wp.array2d(dtype=wp.vec3),
                   peaks: wp.array2d(dtype=float),
                   history: wp.array3d(dtype=wp.vec3),
                   peak_history: wp.array3d(dtype=float),
                   impulse: wp.array2d(dtype=float),
                   loaded: wp.array2d(dtype=wp.int32),
                   both_off_run: wp.array(dtype=wp.int32),
                   both_off_max: wp.array(dtype=wp.int32),
                   dt: float, bin_ticks: int, flush: int):
    e = wp.tid()
    fl = raw[e*2]; fr = raw[e*2+1]
    sums[e,0] = sums[e,0] + fl
    sums[e,1] = sums[e,1] + fr
    peaks[e,0] = wp.max(peaks[e,0],wp.length(fl))
    peaks[e,1] = wp.max(peaks[e,1],wp.length(fr))
    impulse[e,0] = impulse[e,0] + wp.max(fl[2],0.0)*dt
    impulse[e,1] = impulse[e,1] + wp.max(fr[2],0.0)*dt
    if wp.length(fl)>1.0: loaded[e,0] = loaded[e,0]+1
    if wp.length(fr)>1.0: loaded[e,1] = loaded[e,1]+1
    if wp.length(fl)<=1.0 and wp.length(fr)<=1.0:
        both_off_run[e] = both_off_run[e]+1
        both_off_max[e] = wp.max(both_off_max[e],both_off_run[e])
    else:
        both_off_run[e] = 0
    if flush == 1:
        for h in range(2,0,-1):
            history[e,h,0] = history[e,h-1,0]
            history[e,h,1] = history[e,h-1,1]
            peak_history[e,h,0] = peak_history[e,h-1,0]
            peak_history[e,h,1] = peak_history[e,h-1,1]
        history[e,0,0] = sums[e,0]/float(bin_ticks)
        history[e,0,1] = sums[e,1]/float(bin_ticks)
        peak_history[e,0,0] = peaks[e,0]
        peak_history[e,0,1] = peaks[e,1]
        sums[e,0] = wp.vec3(0.0); sums[e,1] = wp.vec3(0.0)
        peaks[e,0] = 0.0; peaks[e,1] = 0.0



@wp.kernel
def capture_crossbin_kernel(raw: wp.array(dtype=wp.vec3),
                   sums: wp.array2d(dtype=wp.vec3), peaks: wp.array2d(dtype=float),
                   history: wp.array3d(dtype=wp.vec3), peak_history: wp.array3d(dtype=float),
                   impulse: wp.array2d(dtype=float), loaded: wp.array2d(dtype=wp.int32),
                   both_off_run: wp.array(dtype=wp.int32), both_off_max: wp.array(dtype=wp.int32),
                   dt: float, first_s: float, first_flush: int, second_s: float):
    e=wp.tid();fl=raw[e*2];fr=raw[e*2+1]
    # Solver-step impulses and diagnostics are counted once, even at a split.
    impulse[e,0]=impulse[e,0]+wp.max(fl[2],0.0)*dt
    impulse[e,1]=impulse[e,1]+wp.max(fr[2],0.0)*dt
    if wp.length(fl)>1.0:loaded[e,0]=loaded[e,0]+1
    if wp.length(fr)>1.0:loaded[e,1]=loaded[e,1]+1
    if wp.length(fl)<=1.0 and wp.length(fr)<=1.0:
        both_off_run[e]=both_off_run[e]+1
        both_off_max[e]=wp.max(both_off_max[e],both_off_run[e])
    else:both_off_run[e]=0
    for part in range(2):
        duration=first_s
        flush=first_flush
        if part==1:
            duration=second_s
            flush=0
        if duration>0.0:
            sums[e,0]=sums[e,0]+fl*duration
            sums[e,1]=sums[e,1]+fr*duration
            peaks[e,0]=wp.max(peaks[e,0],wp.length(fl))
            peaks[e,1]=wp.max(peaks[e,1],wp.length(fr))
            if flush==1:
                for h in range(2,0,-1):
                    history[e,h,0]=history[e,h-1,0]
                    history[e,h,1]=history[e,h-1,1]
                    peak_history[e,h,0]=peak_history[e,h-1,0]
                    peak_history[e,h,1]=peak_history[e,h-1,1]
                history[e,0,0]=sums[e,0]/0.005
                history[e,0,1]=sums[e,1]/0.005
                peak_history[e,0,0]=peaks[e,0];peak_history[e,0,1]=peaks[e,1]
                sums[e,0]=wp.vec3(0.0);sums[e,1]=wp.vec3(0.0)
                peaks[e,0]=0.0;peaks[e,1]=0.0

class IntegratedWheelContact:
    def __init__(self, env):
        if env._physics_handles_decimation:
            raise RuntimeError('Integrated contact requires physical substep scene callbacks')
        self.env=env; self.dt=float(env.physics_dt)
        from physics_clock import validate_clock
        clock=validate_clock(self.dt,float(env.step_dt))
        self.crossbin=clock['cross_bin_required'];self.dt_us=clock['physics_dt_us']
        self.stride=clock['contact_bin_samples'];self.tick=0
        self.sensor=env.scene.sensors['wheel_contact_scut']
        if self.sensor.body_names!=['left_wheel','right_wheel']:
            raise RuntimeError('Wheel capture body order mismatch: '+str(self.sensor.body_names))
        n=env.num_envs;dev=env.device
        self.sums=torch.zeros((n,2,3),device=dev)
        self.peaks=torch.zeros((n,2),device=dev)
        self.history=torch.zeros((n,3,2,3),device=dev)
        self.peak_history=torch.zeros((n,3,2),device=dev)
        self.impulse=torch.zeros((n,2),device=dev)
        self.loaded=torch.zeros((n,2),dtype=torch.int32,device=dev)
        self.off_run=torch.zeros(n,dtype=torch.int32,device=dev)
        self.off_max=torch.zeros(n,dtype=torch.int32,device=dev)
        self._arrays=[wp.from_torch(self.sums,dtype=wp.vec3),wp.from_torch(self.peaks),
                     wp.from_torch(self.history,dtype=wp.vec3),wp.from_torch(self.peak_history),
                     wp.from_torch(self.impulse),wp.from_torch(self.loaded),
                     wp.from_torch(self.off_run),wp.from_torch(self.off_max)]
        env._contact_capture_metadata.update(
            integrated_enabled=True, raw_capture_period_s=self.dt,
            bin_period_s=.005, bin_samples=self.stride, history_bins=3,
            crossbin=self.crossbin, force_between_solver_callbacks='piecewise constant step-average; not measured substep timing',
            reward_source='mean vector force = summed physical impulse /5ms; >1N per-wheel history maximum',
            peak_source='diagnostic only; not reward or graduation',
            adaptation='Aligned legacy kernel retained;2ms solver impulse apportioned by exact integer-time overlap into fixed5ms bins')

    def capture(self, dt):
        if abs(float(dt)-self.dt)>1e-9:raise RuntimeError('Decimated contact callback')
        raw=self.sensor.contact_view.get_net_contact_forces(dt=self.dt).view(wp.vec3)
        self.tick+=1
        if self.crossbin:
            from physics_clock import fragments
            parts=fragments(self.tick,self.dt_us);first,flush=parts[0]
            second=parts[1][0] if len(parts)>1 else 0
            wp.launch(capture_crossbin_kernel,dim=self.env.num_envs,
                      inputs=[raw,*self._arrays,self.dt,first/1000000,int(flush),second/1000000],device=self.env.device)
        else:
            wp.launch(capture_kernel,dim=self.env.num_envs,
                      inputs=[raw,*self._arrays,self.dt,self.stride,int(self.tick%self.stride==0)],device=self.env.device)

    def begin_control(self):
        self.impulse.zero_();self.loaded.zero_()

    def reset(self, ids):
        for t in [self.sums,self.peaks,self.history,self.peak_history,self.impulse,
                  self.loaded,self.off_run,self.off_max]:t[ids]=0

    per={k:v/counts.clamp_min(1) for k,v in sums.items()}
    strict=alive & (counts>0) & (per['vel_error']<=torch.maximum(torch.full_like(targets,.12),targets.abs()*.25)) & (per['tilt']<=8) & (per['height_error']<=.03) & (per['both_wheels']>=.9) & (per['delta']<=.18) & (per['d2']<=.25)
    groups=[]
    for target in [0.,1.,-1.5,1.5]:
        ids=(targets-target).abs()<.001; validrows=ids & (counts>0)
        d={'command_vx':target,'environments':int(ids.sum()),'survival_fraction':float(alive[ids].float().mean()),'strict_pass':float(strict[ids].float().mean()),'first_failure_step_mean':float(firstdone[ids].float().mean()),'sampled_envs':int(validrows.sum())}
        if abs(args.steps*env.step_dt-15.)<1e-6:d['survival_15s']=d['survival_fraction']
        for k,v in per.items():d[k]=float(v[validrows].mean()) if validrows.any() else None
        groups.append(d)
    result={'mode':'reset_smoke' if args.reset_smoke else 'deterministic_policy','checkpoint':args.checkpoint,
            'seed':args.seed,'steps':args.steps,'seconds':args.steps*env.step_dt,'elapsed_s':time.time()-start,
            'groups':groups,'max_closure_after_grace_m':maxclosure,'max_mimic_after_grace_rad':maxmimic,
            'first_step_closure_max_m':max(reset_closures) if reset_closures else None,'first_pose':first_pose,'nonfinite':nonfinite,'resets':resets,
            'wheel_sensor_body_order':list(env.scene.sensors['wheel_contact'].body_names),
            'scut_contact_window':'actual update interval measured below; no claim of simultaneous continuous loading',
            'metric_population':'per-environment means after first 0.5 s, censored at FIRST termination; survival denominator includes all environments',
            'physics_pass':not nonfinite and maxclosure<.002 and maxmimic<.01}
    result['strict_pass']=result['physics_pass'] and all(g['strict_pass']>=.8 for g in groups)
    env.scene.update=original_update
    traces=torch.stack(samples).cpu().numpy()
    stamps=torch.stack(history_stamp).cpu().numpy()
    trace_path=str(Path(args.output).with_suffix('.npz'))
    np.savez_compressed(trace_path,values=traces,dt=np.array(sample_dt),history_timestamp=stamps,
        columns=np.array(['left_fz','right_fz','left_force_norm','right_force_norm','left_gap','right_gap',
            'left_vz','right_vz','root_z','root_vz','speed','left_support_slip','right_support_slip']))
    elapsed=np.cumsum(sample_dt);steady=elapsed>1.0;data=traces[steady]
    dt=float(np.median(sample_dt));diag=[]
    def longest_run(mask):
        edges=np.diff(np.r_[False,mask,False].astype(int));start=np.flatnonzero(edges==1);end=np.flatnonzero(edges==-1)
        return float(max(end-start,default=0)*dt)
    for index in range(n):
        valid=(elapsed>1.0) & (elapsed<float(firstdone[index])*env.step_dt)
        a=traces[valid,index]
        if len(a)==0:
            diag.append({'env':index,'command':float(targets[index]),'status':'no surviving samples'});continue
        contacts=a[:,2:4]>1
        baseline=np.array([np.median(a[contacts[:,j],4+j]) if contacts[:,j].any() else np.nan for j in range(2)])
        relative_gap=a[:,4:6]-baseline
        diag.append({'env':index,'command':float(targets[index]),
            'both_contact_physics':float(contacts.all(1).mean()),
            'loaded_gap_baseline_mm':(baseline*1000).tolist(),
            'relative_gap_p99_mm':(np.quantile(relative_gap,.99,axis=0)*1000).tolist(),
            'relative_gap_max_mm':(np.max(relative_gap,axis=0)*1000).tolist(),
            'mean_support_slip_m_s':a[:,11:13].mean(0).tolist(),
            'wheel_vertical_impulse_Ns':(a[:,:2].sum(0)*dt).tolist(),
            'wheel_fz_p99_N':np.quantile(a[:,:2],.99,axis=0).tolist(),
            'neither_contact_physics':float((~contacts.any(1)).mean()),
            'longest_neither_contact_ms':1000*longest_run(~contacts.any(1)),
            'longest_left_off_ms':1000*longest_run(~contacts[:,0]),
            'longest_right_off_ms':1000*longest_run(~contacts[:,1]),
            'both_geom_gap_above_1mm':float((a[:,4:6]>.001).all(1).mean()),
            'gap_min_max_mm':(1000*np.stack([a[:,4:6].min(0),a[:,4:6].max(0)])).tolist(),
            'mean_wheel_fz_N':a[:,:2].mean(0).tolist(),
            'root_z_peak_to_peak_mm':float(1000*np.ptp(a[:,8])),
            'root_vz_rms':float(np.sqrt(np.mean(a[:,9]**2)))})
    result['contact_diagnostic']={'trace':trace_path,'sample_count':len(samples),'median_dt':dt,
        'lazy_sensor_update':bool(env.scene.cfg.lazy_sensor_update),
        'physics_handles_decimation':bool(env._physics_handles_decimation),
        'history_actual_update_intervals_s':np.unique(np.round(np.diff(stamps[:,0])[np.diff(stamps[:,0])>0],5)).tolist(),
        'geometry':'actual USD convexHull input vertex support; excludes PhysX contact/rest offsets and cooking differences; slip at lowest support vertex approximation',
        'mesh_audit':mesh_audit,
        'metrics_after_warmup_seconds':1.,'environments':diag}
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print('RESCUE_RESULT '+json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    env.close()


try:main()

"""Prospective project contact gate. Original report booleans remain unchanged.

No SCUT graduation or real-hardware claim. The 0.15m/s speed is retained but
measured on loaded reported contact points, with explicit sustained-excess veto.
"""
import math
VERSION='loaded_report_point015_duration15ms_v1'
LIMIT=.15
MAX_SUSTAINED_S=.01501
def assess(report):
    pe=report['per_environment'];sub=report.get('substep_contact_readback')
    if not sub:
        return dict(version=VERSION,pass_=False,reasons=['Missing substep contact evidence'],original_spin_skill_pass=report.get('spin_skill_pass'))
    cp=sub['per_environment'];groups=[];individual=[];severe=[]
    complete=(report['seconds']>=15 and not report['nonfinite'] and report['max_closure_m']<=.002 and report['max_mimic_rad']<=.01
              and sub['callbacks']==report['steps']*20 and sub['sampling_s']==.0005)
    for g in report['groups']:
        ids=[i for i,v in enumerate(report['group_ids']) if v==g['group_id']];passing=[]
        for i in ids:
            reasons=[]
            if any(not math.isfinite(values[i]) for values in pe.values()):
                reasons.append('nonfinite_control_evidence');severe.append(dict(env=i,reason='nonfinite_control_evidence'))
            limits=dict(peak_tilt=12,tilt=8,height_error=.03,delta=.18,d2=.25,maximum_gap_m=.002,
                        longest_both_low_s=.01501,guide_force=1,base_force=1,wheel_rating_clip=.2,leg_rating_clip=.2)
            for key,limit in limits.items():
                if not math.isfinite(pe[key][i]) or pe[key][i]>limit:reasons.append(key)
            if not report['alive'][i] or report['first_failure_step'][i]<report['steps']:reasons.append('survival')
            if pe['left_fz'][i]<10 or pe['right_fz'][i]<10:reasons.append('mean_wheel_load')
            if pe['yaw_error'][i]>max(.2,.2*abs(g['wz'])):reasons.append('yaw_error')
            if pe['speed_error'][i]>max(.12,.25*abs(g['vx'])):reasons.append('speed_error')
            if g['wz']!=0 and pe['spin_translation_speed'][i]>.12:reasons.append('spin_translation_speed')
            if g['profile']=='spin_ramp_stop_reverse' and pe['stop_yaw_abs'][i]>.2:reasons.append('stop_yaw_abs')
            for w in (0,1):
                if any(not math.isfinite(cp[key][i][w]) for key in ('loaded_samples','valid_ticks','loaded_time_mean_tangent_speed','loaded_impulse_weighted_tangent_speed','longest_loaded_over015_s','mean_normal_force_N','max_normal_z_error','max_com_link_point_velocity_error')):
                    reasons.append(f'wheel{w}_nonfinite_contact_evidence');severe.append(dict(env=i,wheel=w,reason='nonfinite_contact_evidence'))
                if cp['loaded_samples'][i][w]<=0 or cp['valid_ticks'][i][w]!=(report['steps']-50)*20:
                    reasons.append(f'wheel{w}_missing_contact');severe.append(dict(env=i,wheel=w,reason='missing_contact_evidence'))
                control_force=pe['left_fz' if w==0 else 'right_fz'][i]
                if abs(cp['mean_normal_force_N'][i][w]-control_force)>.1 or cp['max_normal_z_error'][i][w]>.01 or cp['max_com_link_point_velocity_error'][i][w]>.001:
                    reasons.append(f'wheel{w}_readback_consistency');severe.append(dict(env=i,wheel=w,reason='readback_consistency'))
                for key in ('loaded_time_mean_tangent_speed','loaded_impulse_weighted_tangent_speed'):
                    value=cp[key][i][w]
                    if not math.isfinite(value) or value>LIMIT:reasons.append(f'wheel{w}_{key}')
                value=cp['longest_loaded_over015_s'][i][w]
                if not math.isfinite(value) or value>MAX_SUSTAINED_S:
                    reasons.append(f'wheel{w}_sustained_loaded_excess');severe.append(dict(env=i,wheel=w,reason='sustained_loaded_excess',value_s=value))
            if not report['alive'][i] or pe['peak_tilt'][i]>15 or pe['longest_both_low_s'][i]>.02001:severe.append(dict(env=i,reason='original_severe_individual_veto'))
            accepted=not reasons;passing.append(accepted)
            individual.append(dict(env=i,group_id=g['group_id'],pass_=accepted,reasons=reasons,
                                   original_left_mesh_proxy=pe['left_slip'][i],original_right_mesh_proxy=pe['right_slip'][i]))
        groups.append(dict(group_id=g['group_id'],count=len(ids),passing=sum(passing),fraction=sum(passing)/len(ids)))
    audits=all((report.get(k) or {}).get('actual_parameters_pass',False) for k in ('initial_parameter_audit','final_parameter_audit'))
    passed=complete and audits and not severe and all(g['fraction']>=.8 for g in groups)
    return dict(version=VERSION,pass_=bool(passed),complete_evidence=complete,actual_parameters_pass=audits,
                original_spin_skill_pass=report['spin_skill_pass'],legacy_spin_skill_pass=report.get('spin_skill_pass_legacy_reference'),
                original_mesh015_replaced_only_in_new_version=True,groups=groups,individual=individual,severe_individual_veto=severe,
                mean_tangent_speed_limit_m_s=LIMIT,sustained_loaded_excess_limit_s=MAX_SUSTAINED_S,
                scope='Prospective project gate using post-step report-point velocities. Not material-patch tracking or real-robot certification; raw peaks/RMS retained.')

"""Input-hull support and lowest-vertex slip approximation, control-rate only."""
import torch
from isaaclab.utils.math import quat_apply

class ControlGeometry:
    def __init__(self, env, usd_path):
        from pxr import Usd,UsdGeom
        self.env=env;self.robot=env.scene['robot']
        self.reference_version="wheel_link_support_velocity_v2"
        self.ids,_=self.robot.find_bodies(['left_wheel','right_wheel'],preserve_order=True)
        stage=Usd.Stage.Open(usd_path);points=[]
        for name in ['left_wheel','right_wheel']:
            body=stage.GetPrimAtPath('/Robot/links/'+name)
            c=[p for p in Usd.PrimRange(body) if p.GetAttribute('physics:collisionEnabled').Get()]
            if len(c)!=1 or c[0].GetTypeName()!='Mesh':raise RuntimeError('Expected one wheel mesh')
            cache=UsdGeom.XformCache();tf=cache.GetLocalToWorldTransform(c[0])*cache.GetLocalToWorldTransform(body).GetInverse()
            points.append(torch.tensor([list(tf.Transform(v)) for v in UsdGeom.Mesh(c[0]).GetPointsAttr().Get()],device=env.device))
        self.vertices=torch.stack(points)[None].expand(env.num_envs,-1,-1,-1)

    def read(self):
        r=self.robot;n=self.env.num_envs;m=self.vertices.shape[2]
        q=r.data.body_quat_w[:,self.ids]
        rotated=quat_apply(q[:,:,None,:].expand(-1,-1,m,-1).reshape(-1,4),self.vertices.reshape(-1,3)).reshape(n,2,m,3)
        low=rotated[:,:,:,2].argmin(2)
        support=rotated.gather(2,low[:,:,None,None].expand(-1,-1,1,3)).squeeze(2)
        ground=getattr(self.env,'_mod4_ground_z',torch.zeros(n,device=self.env.device))
        gap=r.data.body_pos_w[:,self.ids,2]+support[:,:,2]-ground[:,None]
        vel=r.data.body_link_lin_vel_w[:,self.ids]+torch.cross(r.data.body_ang_vel_w[:,self.ids],support,dim=-1)
        legacy=r.data.body_lin_vel_w[:,self.ids]+torch.cross(r.data.body_ang_vel_w[:,self.ids],support,dim=-1)
        self.legacy_reference_slip=legacy[:,:,:2].norm(dim=-1)
        return gap,vel[:,:,:2].norm(dim=-1)

"""Independent derived CURB geometry, preserving the four background families."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
import numpy as np
import trimesh
PROFILE = Path(__file__).with_name('curb20_profile.json')

def profile():
    p=json.loads(PROFILE.read_bytes())
    assert p['height_m']==.020 and p['strip_width_m']==.150
    assert p['strip_continuous_with_upper_platform'] and p['vertical_riser_unsmoothed']
    assert p['derived_not_actual_RM_geometry'] and p['not_stair_flight']
    return p

def make_mesh(size, mirrored=False):
    p=profile(); assert tuple(map(float,size))==(9.,9.)
    v=np.array(p['vertices'],dtype=np.float64)
    f=np.array(p['triangles'],dtype=np.int64)
    if mirrored:
        v[:,0]*=-1; f=f[:,::-1]
    # TerrainGenerator receives coordinates in [0,size] before its own offset.
    v[:,:2]+=np.asarray(size)*.5
    mesh=trimesh.Trimesh(v,f,process=False)
    assert len(mesh.faces)==8 and np.ptp(v[:,2])==.020
    horizontal=np.ptp(v[f,:,] if False else v[f][:,:,2],axis=1)==0
    assert (mesh.face_normals[horizontal,2]>0).all()
    assert np.allclose(abs(mesh.face_normals[~horizontal,0]),1.)
    return mesh,np.array([4.5,4.5,.020])

def curb_mesh(difficulty,cfg):
    # The unchanged intro range is [0,.25]. Its lower/upper twenty rows mirror
    # the curb. The frozen route independently reads the authored ground sign.
    assert 0. <= difficulty <= .25
    mesh,origin=make_mesh(cfg.size,mirrored=difficulty>=.125)
    return [mesh],origin

def configure_curb(cfg):
    from e1_scene_query_resource import configure_intro
    from isaaclab.terrains.sub_terrain_cfg import SubTerrainBaseCfg
    from isaaclab.utils.configclass import configclass
    recipe=configure_intro(cfg)
    @configclass
    class CurbCfg(SubTerrainBaseCfg):
        function=curb_mesh
    gen=cfg.scene.terrain.terrain_generator
    assert gen.difficulty_range==(0.,.25) and tuple(gen.size)==(9.,9.)
    old=gen.sub_terrains['random_uniform_for_rm']
    gen.sub_terrains['random_uniform_for_rm']=CurbCfg(proportion=old.proportion,size=gen.size)
    recipe['profile']='mod4_CURB_derived20mm_strip150_mirrored_v1'
    recipe['CURB_geometry_change']=dict(revision='MOD4-MOE-TERRAIN-SUBEXPERT-REVISION-004',
        height_m=.020,strip_width_m=.150,profile_sha256=hashlib.sha256(PROFILE.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        vertical_riser_unsmoothed=True,strip_continuous_with_upper_platform=True,
        mirror_threshold_within_unchanged_difficulty_range=.125,
        old_random_height_family_replaced_only=True,other_four_families_unchanged=True,
        proportions_unchanged=True,derived_not_actual_RM002_height=True,not_stair_flight=True)
    return recipe

    per['steady_vel_error']=steady_error/steady_counts.clamp_min(1)
    per['stop_abs_speed']=stop_error/stop_counts.clamp_min(1)
    per['longest_both_low_force_s_substep']=unload_max
    per['left_gap_max_control_m']=gap_max[:,0]
    per['right_gap_max_control_m']=gap_max[:,1]
    per['max_tilt']=max_tilt
    per['longest_wheel_effort_clip_s']=sat_longest
    # Window semantics mirror the upstream reward, but our observed lazy-sensor
    # sampling cadence is 10 ms, not the configured 5 ms. Neither gate is a contest standard.
    common=alive & (counts>0) & (per['vel_error']<=torch.maximum(torch.full_like(targets,.12),targets.abs()*.25)) & (per['tilt']<=8) & (per['height_error']<=.03) & (per['delta']<=.18) & (per['d2']<=.25)
    strict=common & (per['both_wheels_scut_history']>=.9)
    strict_integrated=common & (per['both_wheels_binned_mean']>=.9)
    strict_5ms=common & (per['both_wheels_history_5ms']>=.9)
    strict_instant=common & (per['both_wheels']>=.9)
    # 2026-09-29 追加：逐判据失败计数（只做诊断，不改变 strict 判定）
    crit={'alive':alive,'sampled':counts>0,
          'vel':per['vel_error']<=torch.maximum(torch.full_like(targets,.12),targets.abs()*.25),
          'tilt':per['tilt']<=8,'height':per['height_error']<=.03,
          'contact_window':per['both_wheels_scut_history']>=.9,
          'delta':per['delta']<=.18,'d2':per['d2']<=.25}
    groups=[]
    for group_index,target in enumerate(levels):
        ids=group_ids==group_index; validrows=ids & (counts>0)
        d={'command_vx':target,'environments':int(ids.sum()),'survival_fraction':float(alive[ids].float().mean()),'strict_pass':float(strict[ids].float().mean()),'first_failure_step_mean':float(firstdone[ids].float().mean()),'sampled_envs':int(validrows.sum())}
        d['profile']='ramp_brake_reverse' if args.ramp_suite and group_index>=6 else 'constant'
        d['fail_counts']={k:int((~m & (ids if k in ['alive','sampled'] else validrows)).sum()) for k,m in crit.items()}
        d['strict_pass_window']=d['strict_pass']
        d['strict_pass_window_legacy_capture']=d['strict_pass']
        d['strict_pass_integrated_mean']=float(strict_integrated[ids].float().mean())
        d['strict_pass_window_5ms']=float(strict_5ms[ids].float().mean())
        d['strict_pass_instant_legacy']=float(strict_instant[ids].float().mean())
        if abs(args.steps*env.step_dt-15.)<1e-6:d['survival_15s']=d['survival_fraction']
        for k,v in per.items():d[k]=float(v[validrows].mean()) if validrows.any() else None
        groups.append(d)
    result={'mode':'reset_smoke' if args.reset_smoke else 'deterministic_policy','checkpoint':args.checkpoint,
            'seed':args.seed,'steps':args.steps,'seconds':args.steps*env.step_dt,'elapsed_s':time.time()-start,
            'groups':groups,'max_closure_after_grace_m':maxclosure,'max_mimic_after_grace_rad':maxmimic,
            'first_step_closure_max_m':max(reset_closures) if reset_closures else None,'first_pose':first_pose,'nonfinite':nonfinite,'resets':resets,
            'wheel_sensor_body_order':list(env.scene.sensors['wheel_contact'].body_names),
            'gate_version':'legacy_gate_preserved_with_integrated_and_endpoint_reporting_20260930',
            'scut_contact_window':{'semantics':'per-wheel peak over 3 samples >1N; not simultaneous continuous loading','configured_update_period_s':.005,'actual_update_interval_s_prior_measured':.01,'prior_evidence':'contact_substep_diagnostic.json'},
            'metric_population':'per-environment means after first 0.5 s, censored at FIRST termination; survival denominator includes all environments',
            'physics_pass':not nonfinite and maxclosure<.002 and maxmimic<.01}
    result['per_environment']={k:v.detach().cpu().tolist() for k,v in per.items()}
    result['per_environment'].update(alive=alive.cpu().tolist(), group_ids=group_ids.cpu().tolist())
    result['strict_pass']=result['physics_pass'] and all(g['strict_pass']>=.8 for g in groups)
    # Safety permits learning imperfect speed tracking, but rejects falls,
    # major posture errors, broken closures and persistent actuator clipping.
    result['speed_safety_pass']=result['physics_pass'] and all(
        g['survival_fraction']>=.95 and g['max_tilt'] is not None and g['max_tilt']<=15
        and g['height_error']<=.03 and g['wheel_effort_clip_fraction']<=.2
        and g['leg_effort_clip_fraction']<=.2 and g['longest_wheel_effort_clip_s']<=.5
        and g['wheel_near_no_load']<=.01 and g['base_force']<=1. and g['guide_force']<=1.
        for g in groups)
    result['speed_limit']=args.speed_limit
    result['ramp_suite']=args.ramp_suite
    result['effort_sampling']='10ms control-step snapshots, not substep peak audit; computed-minus-applied >0.1Nm counts clipping'
    result['contact_physical_metrics_semantics']={
        'force_and_low_load':'captured every.5ms; longest both norm force<=1N; low force is not airborne',
        'gap_and_slip':'sampled each10ms control; input USD hull support excludes cooking/offset/compliance; lowest-vertex slip approximation, not contact manifold',
        'group_values':'means of per-environment summaries; individual arrays retained in per_environment, not worst cases',
        'integration':'mean force per5ms impulse bins is a reward adaptation; bin pass is not continuous contact or legacy graduation'}
    result['strict_pass_window']=result['strict_pass']
    result['strict_pass_window_legacy_capture']=result['strict_pass']
    result['strict_pass_integrated_mean']=result['physics_pass'] and all(g['strict_pass_integrated_mean']>=.8 for g in groups)
    result['strict_pass_window_5ms']=result['physics_pass'] and all(g['strict_pass_window_5ms']>=.8 for g in groups)
    result['contact_capture_metadata']=getattr(env,'_contact_capture_metadata',{'enabled':False})
    result['graduation_gate_contact_source']='legacy control-endpoint shadow; corrected 5ms stats do not automatically promote speed'
    result['height_credit_semantics']='unweighted exp height * recent contact; weighted per control step = credit * 0.3 * 0.01'
    result['physical_contact_evidence']='reports/contact_probe_7450_20260930/FINDINGS.md in source root; 2kHz unload/gap/slip retained there, not overwritten by window stats'
    result['strict_pass_instant_legacy']=result['physics_pass'] and all(g['strict_pass_instant_legacy']>=.8 for g in groups)
    Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2));print('RESCUE_RESULT '+json.dumps(result),flush=True)
    env.close()

"""Undeployed SDK candidate: world progress, pure yaw, and actual transitions.

References remain a three-value BODY twist: projected vx, zero vy, signed yaw.
World progress is a complete-cycle requirement, not an instantaneous velocity.
No mass/PD/spring/reward/PPO changes. Real Isaac/PPO acceptance is pending.
"""
import math
import os

import torch
from isaaclab.envs.mdp.commands.velocity_command import UniformVelocityCommand
from spin_translation_math import body_command


def transition_yaw(elapsed, target):
    """12s start/hold/brake/stop/reverse/hold/brake/stop command profile."""
    scale = torch.where(elapsed < 1., elapsed,
             torch.where(elapsed < 4., 1.,
             torch.where(elapsed < 5., 5. - elapsed,
             torch.where(elapsed < 6., 0.,
             torch.where(elapsed < 7., -(elapsed - 6.),
             torch.where(elapsed < 10., -1.,
             torch.where(elapsed < 11., elapsed - 11., 0.)))))))
    return target * scale


class DirectionalSpinCommand(UniformVelocityCommand):
    def __init__(self, cfg, env):
        if cfg.heading_command or cfg.rel_heading_envs != 0:
            raise ValueError('Disable heading correction before directional spin')
        super().__init__(cfg, env)
        self.pure_fraction = float(os.environ.get('RM_PURE_SPIN_FRACTION', '.30'))
        self.moving_fraction = float(os.environ.get('RM_MOVING_SPIN_FRACTION', '.20'))
        self.transition_within_pure = float(os.environ.get('RM_SPIN_TRANSITION_WITHIN_PURE', str(1 / 3)))
        self.progress_goal = float(os.environ.get('RM_SPIN_WORLD_PROGRESS_M_S', '.15'))
        self.body_limit = float(os.environ.get('RM_SPIN_BODY_SPEED_LIMIT_M_S', '1.5'))
        self.pure_max = float(os.environ.get('RM_SPIN_MAX_RAD_S', str(4*math.pi)))
        if not 0 < self.progress_goal <= .5 or not 2 * self.progress_goal <= self.body_limit <= 1.5:
            raise ValueError('World progress .15/.3/.5 requires an unclipped feasible body projection')
        if not 2 <= self.pure_max <= 4*math.pi or not 0 < self.transition_within_pure < 1:
            raise ValueError('Preserved pure spin cap must remain within verified 4pi')
        if not 0 < self.pure_fraction or not 0 < self.moving_fraction:
            raise ValueError('Both pure and moving samples must remain')
        if self.pure_fraction + self.moving_fraction >= 1 - cfg.rel_standing_envs:
            raise ValueError('Retain standing and straight samples')
        if cfg.resampling_time_range[0] < 12:
            raise ValueError('A transition must complete before command resampling')
        self.is_pure_spin = torch.zeros(self.num_envs, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.device)
        self.is_moving_spin = torch.zeros_like(self.is_pure_spin)
        self.is_transition_spin = torch.zeros_like(self.is_pure_spin)
        self.world_direction = torch.zeros(self.num_envs, device=self.device)
        self.signed_yaw = torch.zeros_like(self.world_direction)
        self.phase_elapsed = torch.zeros_like(self.world_direction)
        self._mode_rng = torch.Generator(device=self.device)
        self._mode_rng.manual_seed(int(env.cfg.seed or 0) + 15485863)
        self._dt = float(env.step_dt)
        self.manual_evaluation_mode = False

    def set_manual_evaluation_mode(self):
        """Frozen probes own their command references; never override them."""
        self.manual_evaluation_mode = True
        self.is_pure_spin[:] = False
        self.is_moving_spin[:] = False
        self.is_transition_spin[:] = False

    def _resample_command(self, env_ids):
        super()._resample_command(env_ids)
        ids = torch.as_tensor(env_ids, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device)
        u = torch.rand((len(ids), 5), generator=self._mode_rng, device=self.device)
        available = ~self.is_standing_env[ids]
        pure_end = self.pure_fraction / (1 - self.cfg.rel_standing_envs)
        moving_end = pure_end + self.moving_fraction / (1 - self.cfg.rel_standing_envs)
        pure = available & (u[:, 0] < pure_end)
        moving = available & (u[:, 0] >= pure_end) & (u[:, 0] < moving_end)
        transition = pure & (u[:, 4] < self.transition_within_pure)
        self.is_pure_spin[ids] = pure
        self.is_moving_spin[ids] = moving
        self.is_transition_spin[ids] = transition
        self.is_heading_env[ids] = False
        sign = torch.where(u[:, 2] < .5, -1., 1.)
        rate = torch.where(moving, 1 + u[:, 1], 1 + (self.pure_max - 1) * u[:, 1])
        self.signed_yaw[ids] = torch.where(pure | moving, sign * rate, 0.)
        self.world_direction[ids] = 2 * math.pi * u[:, 3] - math.pi
        self.phase_elapsed[ids] = 0.
        self.vel_command_b[ids, 2] = self.signed_yaw[ids]
        self.vel_command_b[ids[pure], :2] = 0.
        self._write_dynamic(ids)

    def _write_dynamic(self, ids):
        moving = ids[self.is_moving_spin[ids]]
        heading = self.robot.data.heading_w.torch[moving]
        vx, vy = body_command(self.progress_goal, self.world_direction[moving], heading, self.body_limit)
        self.vel_command_b[moving, 0] = vx
        self.vel_command_b[moving, 1] = vy
        self.vel_command_b[moving, 2] = self.signed_yaw[moving]
        transitions = ids[self.is_transition_spin[ids]]
        self.vel_command_b[transitions, 2] = transition_yaw(self.phase_elapsed[transitions], self.signed_yaw[transitions])
        self.vel_command_b[self.is_standing_env, :] = 0.

    def _update_command(self):
        super()._update_command()
        if not self.manual_evaluation_mode:
            self._write_dynamic(torch.arange(self.num_envs, device=self.device))
            self.phase_elapsed += self._dt


def configure(cfg):
    term = cfg.commands.twist
    term.class_type = DirectionalSpinCommand
    term.heading_command = False
    term.rel_heading_envs = 0.
    term.ranges.heading = None
    limit = float(os.environ.get('RM_SPIN_MAX_RAD_S', '3.'))
    term.ranges.ang_vel_z = (-limit, limit)
    term.ranges.lin_vel_y = (0., 0.)
    term.rel_standing_envs = .1
    # Explicit new curriculum: complete turns and full train-time transitions.
    term.resampling_time_range = (12., 16.)
    cfg.curriculum.gyro_window = None


def audit(env):
    term = env.command_manager.get_term('twist')
    if not isinstance(term, DirectionalSpinCommand):
        raise RuntimeError('Directional stage must install its actual SDK command class')
    c = term.command
    if term.cfg.heading_command or term.is_heading_env.any() or not torch.isfinite(c).all():
        raise RuntimeError('Heading override or nonfinite command')
    pure, moving = term.is_pure_spin, term.is_moving_spin
    if (pure & moving).any() or (moving & term.is_standing_env).any():
        raise RuntimeError('Command modes overlap')
    if pure.any() and c[pure, :2].abs().max() > 1e-6:
        raise RuntimeError('Preserved pure spin may not translate')
    if c[:, 1].abs().max() > 1e-6 or c[:, 2].abs().max() > term.pure_max + 1e-5:
        raise RuntimeError('Lateral body motion or yaw beyond admitted cap')
    projection_error = 0.
    if moving.any() and not term.manual_evaluation_mode:
        vx, _ = body_command(term.progress_goal, term.world_direction[moving],
                             term.robot.data.heading_w.torch[moving], term.body_limit)
        projection_error = float((vx - c[moving, 0]).abs().max())
        if projection_error > 1e-6 or c[moving, 2].abs().max() > 2.00001:
            raise RuntimeError('World-to-body reference or moving yaw bound mismatch')
    return {'stage': 'directional_spin_v1', 'command_frame': 'body',
            'manual_frozen_evaluation': term.manual_evaluation_mode,
            'world_progress_goal_m_s': term.progress_goal, 'projection_error_m_s': projection_error,
            'pure_fraction_actual': float(pure.float().mean()),
            'moving_fraction_actual': float(moving.float().mean()),
            'transition_fraction_actual': float(term.is_transition_spin.float().mean()),
            'stand_fraction_actual': float(term.is_standing_env.float().mean()),
            'pure_max_rad_s': term.pure_max, 'moving_yaw_max_rad_s': 2.,
            'world_progress_achieved': 'unmeasured; actual displacement and complete cycles required'}

"""Exact triangle partition for PhysX cooking; no geometry simplification."""
import hashlib,numpy as np,trimesh
from isaaclab.terrains import TerrainImporter

def chunks(mesh,max_faces=25000):
    if max_faces<=0:raise ValueError('Invalid face partition bound')
    for start in range(0,len(mesh.faces),max_faces):
        faces=np.asarray(mesh.faces[start:start+max_faces],dtype=np.int64)
        vertex_ids,inverse=np.unique(faces,return_inverse=True)
        part=trimesh.Trimesh(vertices=np.asarray(mesh.vertices)[vertex_ids],faces=inverse.reshape(-1,3),process=False)
        # Exact world triangles and winding, not a decimated collision proxy.
        assert np.array_equal(part.vertices[part.faces],np.asarray(mesh.vertices)[faces])
        yield start,part

class ChunkedTerrainImporter(TerrainImporter):
    def import_mesh(self,name,mesh):
        source=hashlib.sha256();partition=hashlib.sha256();rows=[]
        for start,part in chunks(mesh):
            # USD points are float32; compare the same authored precision.
            source.update(np.asarray(mesh.vertices,dtype='<f4')[mesh.faces[start:start+len(part.faces)]].tobytes())
            partition.update(np.asarray(part.vertices,dtype='<f4')[part.faces].tobytes())
            part_name=f'{name}_part{len(rows):04d}'
            super().import_mesh(part_name,part)
            rows.append(dict(name=part_name,faces=len(part.faces),vertices=len(part.vertices),start_face=start))
        assert source.hexdigest()==partition.hexdigest()
        assert sum(p['faces'] for p in rows)==len(mesh.faces)
        self.exact_partition_receipt=dict(pass_=True,source_triangles=len(mesh.faces),collider_count=len(rows),max_faces_per_collider=25000,
            triangle_world_f32_order_sha256=source.hexdigest(),partition_triangle_world_f32_order_sha256=partition.hexdigest(),
            all_faces_and_winding_retained=True,geometry_simplified=False,parts=rows)

"""Trainable intro reset: original full-pose geometry, chunked complete footprint."""
import hashlib, json, numpy as np, torch
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from e1_rough_reset_tensor import tangent_frame, joint_permutation
from e1_rough_ground import AuthoredTerrainRaycast
import mod4_task as task
A=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def query(env):
    if not hasattr(env, '_rough_probe_query'):
        env._rough_probe_query = AuthoredTerrainRaycast(env.sim.stage, env.device)
    return env._rough_probe_query

def full_reset(env, env_ids):
    robot = env.scene['robot']
    ids = torch.arange(env.num_envs, device=env.device) if env_ids is None else env_ids
    if not len(ids): return
    if not hasattr(env, '_rough_probe_bank'):
        meta = json.loads((A / 'MOD4_RESET_COLLISION_BANK.json').read_text())
        assert hashlib.sha256(Path(task.USD_PATH).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == meta['usd_sha256']
        assert hashlib.sha256((task.MOD4_ISAAC / 'import_contract.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == meta['contract_sha256']
        bank = np.load(A / 'MOD4_RESET_COLLISION_BANK.npz')
        perm = joint_permutation(list(bank['joint_names']), robot.joint_names)
        pick = int(np.argmin(abs(bank['root_height'] - .25)))
        env._rough_probe_bank = dict(q=torch.as_tensor(bank['q'][pick, perm], device=env.device, dtype=torch.float32),
            points=torch.as_tensor(bank['points_root'][pick], device=env.device, dtype=torch.float32),
            pose_index=pick, meta=meta)
    bank = env._rough_probe_bank
    ray = query(env)
    xy = env.scene.env_origins[ids, :2].clone()
    # Odd environments deliberately move off the flat central spawn platform.
    # Independent env grid already samples terrain; remove diagnostic off-platform offset.
    # No two robots are intentionally placed at the same XYZ.
    ceiling = float(ray.geometry.vertices[:, 2].max()) + 2.
    starts = torch.cat((xy, torch.full((len(ids), 1), ceiling, device=env.device)), dim=1)
    # Per-call grouping of identical reset XY only, not a persistent ground cache.
    unique_xy, inverse = torch.unique(xy,dim=0,return_inverse=True)
    unique_starts=torch.cat((unique_xy,torch.full((len(unique_xy),1),ceiling,device=env.device)),dim=1)
    unique_ground=ray.cast(unique_starts[:,None].contiguous(),10.)
    root_ground={k:v[inverse] for k,v in unique_ground.items()}
    work_xy=unique_xy
    work_ground=unique_ground
    assert root_ground['hit'].all() and (root_ground['normal'][..., 2] > 0).all()
    frames = np.stack([tangent_frame(n) for n in work_ground['normal'][:, 0].cpu().numpy()])
    rotations = torch.as_tensor(frames, device=env.device, dtype=torch.float32)
    z_unique = torch.empty(len(work_xy), device=env.device)
    minimum_clearance = float('inf')
    for first in range(0, len(work_xy), 64):
        last = min(first + 64, len(work_xy))
        offsets = torch.einsum('nij,pj->npi', rotations[first:last], bank['points'])
        footprint = offsets.clone()
        footprint[:, :, :2] += work_xy[first:last, None, :]
        footprint[:, :, 2] = ceiling
        surface = ray.cast(footprint.contiguous(), 10.)
        if not surface['hit'].all():
            raise RuntimeError('Sampled complete collider footprint outside real mesh')
        placed = (surface['height'] + .002 - offsets[:, :, 2]).amax(1)
        clear = placed[:, None] + offsets[:, :, 2] - surface['height']
        if not torch.isfinite(clear).all() or float(clear.min()) < .002 - 1e-5:
            raise RuntimeError('Sampled full-pose terrain placement is invalid')
        z_unique[first:last] = placed
        minimum_clearance = min(minimum_clearance, float(clear.min()))
    z=z_unique[inverse]
    frames=frames[inverse.cpu().numpy()]
    q = bank['q'][None].repeat(len(ids), 1)
    robot.write_joint_state_to_sim(q, torch.zeros_like(q), env_ids=ids)
    state = robot.data.root_state_w[ids].clone()
    state[:, :2] = xy; state[:, 2] = z
    state[:, 3:7] = torch.as_tensor(Rotation.from_matrix(frames).as_quat(), device=env.device, dtype=state.dtype)
    state[:, 7:] = 0.
    robot.write_root_state_to_sim(state, env_ids=ids)
    task.height_cmd(env)[ids] = .25
    env._mod4_ground_z = torch.zeros(env.num_envs, device=env.device) if not hasattr(env, '_mod4_ground_z') else env._mod4_ground_z
    env._mod4_ground_z[ids] = root_ground['height'][:, 0]
    if not hasattr(env, '_rough_probe_expected_q'):
        env._rough_probe_expected_q = torch.zeros((env.num_envs, 30), device=env.device)
    env._rough_probe_expected_q[ids] = q
    if not hasattr(env, '_rough_spawn_xy'):
        env._rough_spawn_xy = torch.zeros((env.num_envs, 2), device=env.device)
    env._rough_spawn_xy[ids] = xy
    env._rough_query_tick = None
    env._rough_probe_reset_receipt = dict(pose_index=bank['pose_index'], full_joint_names=robot.joint_names,
        qd_all_zero_requested=True, root_velocity_all_zero_requested=True,

        root_xyz=state[:, :3].cpu().tolist(), terrain_normal=root_ground['normal'][:, 0].cpu().tolist(),
        surface_sampling_not_continuous_nonpenetration=True)

"""Ground queries for the actual static terrain collider, before MOD4 Rough integration.

The CPU oracle is deliberately independent of Isaac/Warp and is for small audits.
The runtime path builds a Warp mesh from the same authored world-space triangles.
No analytic height map, RMUC fallback, or infinite ground plane is introduced.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np


@dataclass
class TerrainTriangles:
    vertices: np.ndarray
    faces: np.ndarray
    collider_paths: tuple[str, ...]

    def __post_init__(self):
        self.vertices = np.asarray(self.vertices, dtype=np.float64)
        self.faces = np.asarray(self.faces, dtype=np.int64)
        if self.vertices.ndim != 2 or self.vertices.shape[1] != 3:
            raise ValueError("Expected world-space vertices [V,3]")
        if self.faces.ndim != 2 or self.faces.shape[1] != 3 or len(self.faces) == 0:
            raise ValueError("Expected nonempty triangular faces [F,3]")
        if not np.isfinite(self.vertices).all():
            raise ValueError("Nonfinite terrain vertices")
        if self.faces.min() < 0 or self.faces.max() >= len(self.vertices):
            raise ValueError("Terrain face index outside vertex array")

    def receipt(self):
        return {
            "collider_paths": list(self.collider_paths),
            "vertices": len(self.vertices),
            "triangles": len(self.faces),
            "bounds_w": [self.vertices.min(0).tolist(), self.vertices.max(0).tolist()],
            "triangles_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                self.vertices.astype("<f8").tobytes() + self.faces.astype("<i8").tobytes()
            ).hexdigest(),
        }

    @classmethod
    def from_stage(cls, stage, prim_root="/World/ground"):
        """Read enabled static Mesh colliders and their final USD world transforms.

        Reject approximated or dynamic meshes: their authored triangles would not
        identify the collision surface. A cooked PhysX comparison is still required
        before production, since authored geometry is not the contact manifold.
        """
        from pxr import Usd, UsdGeom, UsdPhysics

        if UsdGeom.GetStageUpAxis(stage) != UsdGeom.Tokens.z:
            raise ValueError("Terrain stage must use Z up")
        if abs(UsdGeom.GetStageMetersPerUnit(stage) - 1.0) > 1e-9:
            raise ValueError("Terrain stage must use metres")
        root = stage.GetPrimAtPath(prim_root)
        if not root or not root.IsValid():
            raise ValueError(f"Actual terrain prim absent: {prim_root}")
        cache = UsdGeom.XformCache()
        points, triangles, paths = [], [], []
        offset = 0
        for prim in Usd.PrimRange(root):
            if not prim.IsA(UsdGeom.Mesh) or not prim.HasAPI(UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI):
                continue
            if not UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI(prim).GetCollisionEnabledAttr().Get():
                continue
            parent = prim
            while parent and parent.IsValid():
                if parent.HasAPI(UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI):
                    raise ValueError(f"Terrain collider belongs to a rigid body: {prim.GetPath()}")
                parent = parent.GetParent()
            if prim.HasAPI(UsdPhysics.MeshCollisionAPI):
                approximation = UsdPhysics.MeshCollisionAPI(prim).GetApproximationAttr().Get()
                if approximation not in (None, "none"):
                    raise ValueError(f"Terrain mesh approximation is {approximation}")
            mesh = UsdGeom.Mesh(prim)
            if mesh.GetHoleIndicesAttr().Get():
                raise ValueError("Mesh hole faces need explicit support")
            vertices = np.asarray(mesh.GetPointsAttr().Get(), dtype=np.float64)
            counts = np.asarray(mesh.GetFaceVertexCountsAttr().Get(), dtype=np.int64)
            indices = np.asarray(mesh.GetFaceVertexIndicesAttr().Get(), dtype=np.int64)
            if counts.sum() != len(indices) or np.any(counts < 3):
                raise ValueError("Invalid terrain polygon topology")
            # TerrainGenerator authors triangles. Reject arbitrary n-gons instead
            # of assuming a fan triangulation matches PhysX cooking.
            if np.any(counts != 3):
                raise ValueError("Terrain collider must be explicitly triangulated")
            faces = indices.reshape(-1, 3).copy()
            if mesh.GetOrientationAttr().Get() == UsdGeom.Tokens.leftHanded:
                faces = faces[:, [0, 2, 1]]
            tf = np.asarray(cache.GetLocalToWorldTransform(prim), dtype=np.float64)
            world = np.column_stack((vertices, np.ones(len(vertices)))) @ tf
            if not np.allclose(world[:, 3], 1.0):
                raise ValueError("Projective transform cannot be a terrain collider")
            points.append(world[:, :3])
            triangles.append(faces + offset)
            paths.append(str(prim.GetPath()))
            offset += len(vertices)
        if not paths:
            raise ValueError(f"No enabled triangular collider under {prim_root}")
        return cls(np.concatenate(points), np.concatenate(triangles), tuple(paths))


class VerticalMeshOracle:
    """Small CPU audit of downward rays, including discontinuities and ray misses."""

    def __init__(self, terrain: TerrainTriangles):
        self.terrain = terrain
        self.triangles = terrain.vertices[terrain.faces]

    def cast(self, starts, max_distance=10.0):
        starts = np.asarray(starts, dtype=np.float64)
        if starts.shape[-1] != 3 or not np.isfinite(starts).all() or max_distance <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Invalid downward ray")
        out_shape = starts.shape[:-1]
        heights = np.full(starts.reshape(-1, 3).shape[0], np.nan)
        normals = np.full((len(heights), 3), np.nan)
        face_ids = np.full(len(heights), -1, dtype=np.int64)
        a = self.triangles[:, 0]
        b = self.triangles[:, 1] - a
        c = self.triangles[:, 2] - a
        det = b[:, 0] * c[:, 1] - b[:, 1] * c[:, 0]
        valid = abs(det) > 1e-12  # Vertical walls do not define a downward height.
        normal = np.cross(b, c)
        normal /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(normal, axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-30)
        for i, point in enumerate(starts.reshape(-1, 3)):
            d = point[:2] - a[:, :2]
            u = np.zeros(len(a)); v = np.zeros(len(a))
            u[valid] = (d[valid, 0] * c[valid, 1] - d[valid, 1] * c[valid, 0]) / det[valid]
            v[valid] = (b[valid, 0] * d[valid, 1] - b[valid, 1] * d[valid, 0]) / det[valid]
            z = a[:, 2] + u * b[:, 2] + v * c[:, 2]
            hit = valid & (u >= -1e-9) & (v >= -1e-9) & (u + v <= 1 + 1e-9)
            hit &= (z <= point[2] + 1e-9) & (z >= point[2] - max_distance)
            candidates = np.flatnonzero(hit)
            if len(candidates):
                j = candidates[np.argmax(z[candidates])]
                heights[i] = z[j]; normals[i] = normal[j]; face_ids[i] = j
        return {
            "height": heights.reshape(out_shape),
            "normal": normals.reshape(out_shape + (3,)),
            "hit": (face_ids >= 0).reshape(out_shape),
            "face_id": face_ids.reshape(out_shape),
        }


class AuthoredTerrainRaycast:
    """GPU query bound only to terrain triangles from the live USD stage.

    Construct after scene spawning; callers must terminate/reject misses explicitly.
    This module does not replace production ground-height or reset functions yet.
    """

    def __init__(self, stage, device, prim_root="/World/ground"):
        from isaaclab.utils.warp import convert_to_warp_mesh
        self.geometry = TerrainTriangles.from_stage(stage, prim_root)
        self.mesh = convert_to_warp_mesh(self.geometry.vertices, self.geometry.faces, str(device))

    def cast(self, starts, max_distance=10.0):
        import torch
        from isaaclab.utils.warp import raycast_mesh
        if starts.ndim != 3 or starts.shape[-1] != 3:
            raise ValueError("SDK requires [environment,ray,xyz] starts")
        directions = torch.zeros_like(starts); directions[..., 2] = -1
        hits, distances, normals, faces = raycast_mesh(
            starts.contiguous(), directions, self.mesh, max_dist=max_distance,
            return_distance=True, return_normal=True, return_face_id=True,
        )
        return {"height": hits[..., 2], "normal": normals,
                "distance": distances, "face_id": faces,
                "hit": (faces >= 0) & torch.isfinite(hits).all(-1)}


def clear_vertical_placement(points_root, root_xy, yaw, terrain: VerticalMeshOracle,
                             clearance=0.002):
    """Audit a complete FK collision point cloud before writing a reset pose.

    Returns minimum root Z with every supplied collision point above terrain.
    It does not compute FK or guarantee stability on an edge. A complete USD/MJCF
    point cloud and independent closure, clearance and support checks remain needed.
    """
    points = np.asarray(points_root, dtype=np.float64)
    if points.ndim != 2 or points.shape[1] != 3 or len(points) == 0:
        raise ValueError("Reset requires a nonempty complete collision point cloud")
    if clearance < 0 or not np.isfinite(yaw):
        raise ValueError("Invalid reset clearance/yaw")
    c, s = np.cos(yaw), np.sin(yaw)
    rot = np.array([[c, -s, 0], [s, c, 0], [0, 0, 1]])
    world_offsets = points @ rot.T
    xy = world_offsets[:, :2] + np.asarray(root_xy)
    ceiling = float(terrain.terrain.vertices[:, 2].max()) + 1.0
    starts = np.column_stack((xy, np.full(len(xy), ceiling)))
    distance = ceiling - float(terrain.terrain.vertices[:, 2].min()) + 1.0
    query = terrain.cast(starts, max_distance=distance)
    if not query["hit"].all():
        raise ValueError("Reset footprint extends outside actual terrain")
    if np.any(query["normal"][:, 2] <= 0):
        raise ValueError("Reset hits back-facing/underside terrain")
    z = float(np.max(query["height"] + clearance - world_offsets[:, 2]))
    gaps = z + world_offsets[:, 2] - query["height"]
    return {"root_z": z, "minimum_point_clearance": float(gaps.min()),
            "maximum_point_clearance": float(gaps.max())}

"""Pinned SCUT V14 Rough v1 terrain configuration for an isolated MOD4 adapter.

Call only after Isaac App initialization. This constructs a config; it does not
change the running trainer, its budget, reset logic, or observation dimensions.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import types


COMMIT = "b8ff79f3df855faf9dc92f4a282bd80c42649466"
HEIGHT_FIELD_SHA = "5f444236205f6ab4a56e0c76387b388d5d2d5a7a83ab63386f5cf15ae5b68d0e"
SOURCE = Path(__file__).parent / "pinned_source" / "height_field.py"
RECIPE = Path(__file__).parent / "ROUGH_V1_RESOLVED_RECIPE.json"


def load_custom_terrains():
    """Preserve upstream function bytes; adapt only the SDK decorator import.

    This Isaac build exposes isaaclab.utils.configclass as a module depending on
    import order. The explicit callable import is required by its own SDK code.
    The original pinned file is kept unedited and its hash checked before loading.
    """
    source = SOURCE.read_bytes()
    if hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() != HEIGHT_FIELD_SHA:
        raise ValueError("SCUT custom terrain source does not match pinned commit")
    name = "_mod4_scut_pinned_height_field"
    existing = sys.modules.get(name)
    if existing is not None:
        return existing
    tree = ast.parse(source.decode("utf-8"), filename=str(SOURCE))
    replaced = 0
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == "isaaclab.utils":
            if [a.name for a in node.names] == ["configclass"]:
                node.module = "isaaclab.utils.configclass"
                replaced += 1
    if replaced != 1:
        raise ValueError("Pinned SDK compatibility edit no longer matches")
    module = types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__ = str(SOURCE)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    try:
        exec(compile(tree, str(SOURCE), "exec"), module.__dict__)
    except Exception:
        sys.modules.pop(name, None)
        raise
    return module


def make_terrain_cfg(num_envs, *, seed=20261002, profile="upstream_v1"):
    """Return TerrainImporterCfg, plus an explicit adaptation receipt.

    upstream_v1 retains all 11 active families and their numerical parameters.
    intro_v1 is an explicitly labelled MOD4 entry subset; it excludes cliffs and
    15 cm stairs until legal resets and airborne behavior are independently tested.
    Neither profile silently spawns a Plane below the generated mesh.
    """
    import isaaclab.sim as sim_utils
    import isaaclab.terrains as terrain_gen
    from isaaclab.terrains import TerrainImporterCfg
    from isaaclab.terrains.terrain_generator_cfg import TerrainGeneratorCfg

    recipe = json.loads(RECIPE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if recipe["commit"] != COMMIT or len(recipe["active_terrain_definitions"]) != 11:
        raise ValueError("Unexpected terrain recipe identity")
    custom = load_custom_terrains()
    if profile not in ("upstream_v1", "intro_v1"):
        raise ValueError("Unknown isolated Rough profile")
    intro_weights = {
        "plane_for_rm": .30, "tiny_step": .20, "slope_for_rm_high": .20,
        "inv_slope_for_rm_low": .15, "random_uniform_for_rm": .15,
    }
    terrain_configs = {}
    for definition in recipe["active_terrain_definitions"]:
        key = definition["key"]
        if profile == "intro_v1" and key not in intro_weights:
            continue
        class_name = definition["class"]
        if class_name.startswith("terrain_gen."):
            cls = getattr(terrain_gen, class_name.split(".", 1)[1])
        else:
            cls = getattr(custom, class_name)
        kwargs = definition["parameters"].copy()
        # The AST recipe is serialized through JSON; restore authored range tuples.
        kwargs = {k: tuple(v) if isinstance(v, list) else v for k, v in kwargs.items()}
        if profile == "intro_v1":
            kwargs["proportion"] = intro_weights[key]
        terrain_configs[key] = cls(**kwargs)
    settings = recipe["generator_source_settings"].copy()
    for key in ("size", "difficulty_range"):
        settings[key] = tuple(settings[key])
    settings.update(seed=seed, curriculum=True, sub_terrains=terrain_configs)
    generator = TerrainGeneratorCfg(**settings)
    cfg = TerrainImporterCfg(
        prim_path="/World/ground", terrain_type="generator",
        terrain_generator=generator, num_envs=num_envs,
        collision_group=-1, max_init_terrain_level=0,
        physics_material=sim_utils.RigidBodyMaterialCfg(
            static_friction=1.0, dynamic_friction=1.0, restitution=0.0,
            friction_combine_mode="multiply", restitution_combine_mode="multiply"),
        debug_vis=False,
    )
    receipt = {
        "upstream_commit": COMMIT, "profile": profile,
        "families": list(terrain_configs), "custom_source_sha256": HEIGHT_FIELD_SHA,
        "source_compatibility_edits": ["explicit callable configclass import"],
        "mod4_curriculum_adaptations": ["fixed seed", "initial terrain level 0"],
        "stage": "CONFIG_CANDIDATE_NOT_RUNTIME_ACCEPTED",
        "infinite_plane_below_terrain": False,
        "reset_adapter_installed": False, "production_modified": False,
    }
    if profile == "intro_v1":
        receipt["mod4_curriculum_adaptations"] += [
            "five-family entry subset, explicit proportions", "cliff and stair families deferred"]
        receipt["subset_proportions"] = intro_weights
    return cfg, receipt

"""Full-pose placement math for an isolated, sampled-surface rough reset.

This is not a continuous collider penetration test or a training reset approval.
All 30 joints are written, including wheels, passive links, mimics and rollers.
"""
import numpy as np

def tangent_frame(normal, heading=0.):
    z = np.asarray(normal, dtype=np.float64)
    if z.shape != (3,) or not np.isfinite(z).all() or np.linalg.norm(z) < 1e-8 or z[2] <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Missing or downward terrain normal')
    z = z / np.linalg.norm(z)
    x = np.array([np.cos(heading), np.sin(heading), 0.])
    x -= z * np.dot(x, z)
    if np.linalg.norm(x) < 1e-8:
        raise ValueError('Degenerate tangent direction')
    x /= np.linalg.norm(x)
    y = np.cross(z, x)
    frame = np.column_stack((x, y, z))
    assert np.allclose(frame.T @ frame, np.eye(3), atol=1e-12)
    assert np.linalg.det(frame) > .999999
    return frame

def joint_permutation(bank_names, robot_names):
    if len(bank_names) != 30 or len(robot_names) != 30 or len(set(bank_names)) != 30 or set(bank_names) != set(robot_names):
        raise ValueError('Require the exact complete 30-joint plant')
    return np.array([list(bank_names).index(n) for n in robot_names], dtype=np.int64)

def sampled_vertical_placement(offsets, terrain_heights, hit, clearance=.002):
    offsets = np.asarray(offsets, dtype=np.float64)
    heights = np.asarray(terrain_heights, dtype=np.float64)
    hit = np.asarray(hit, dtype=bool)
    if offsets.ndim != 2 or offsets.shape[1] != 3 or heights.shape != offsets.shape[:1] or hit.shape != heights.shape:
        raise ValueError('Incomplete footprint geometry')
    if not np.isfinite(offsets).all() or not np.isfinite(heights).all() or not hit.all() or clearance < 0:
        raise ValueError('Missing/nonfinite terrain; no cached-floor fallback')
    z = np.max(heights + clearance - offsets[:, 2])
    return float(z), z + offsets[:, 2] - heights

def cpu_contract():
    tests = 0
    for slope in (-.15, 0., .15):
        frame = tangent_frame([-slope, 0., 1.])
        assert np.allclose(frame[:, 2], np.array([-slope, 0., 1.]) / np.linalg.norm([-slope, 0., 1.]))
        assert np.allclose(frame @ frame.T, np.eye(3))
        tests += 1
    names = ['j' + str(i) for i in range(30)]
    assert list(joint_permutation(names, names[::-1])) == list(range(29, -1, -1)); tests += 1
    points = np.array([[0., 0., -.25], [.2, 0., -.2], [-.2, .2, -.2]])
    z, gaps = sampled_vertical_placement(points, np.zeros(3), np.ones(3, bool))
    assert abs(z - .252) < 1e-12 and gaps.min() >= .002 - 1e-12; tests += 1

        else:
            raise AssertionError('Expected missing/model/miss rejection')
    return dict(pass_=True, meaningful_contracts=tests, no_simulation=True, training_reset_approved=False)

class RoughStraightCommand(DirectionalSpinCommand):
    """20% stand, remaining uniform BODY vx[-.3,.3]; vy/yaw exactly zero."""
    def _resample_command(self, env_ids):
        super()._resample_command(env_ids)
        ids=torch.as_tensor(env_ids,device=self.device,dtype=torch.long)
        self.is_pure_spin[ids]=False
        self.is_moving_spin[ids]=False
        self.is_transition_spin[ids]=False
        self.signed_yaw[ids]=0.
        self.vel_command_b[ids,:]=0.
        self.vel_command_b[ids,0]=.6*torch.rand(len(ids),generator=self._mode_rng,device=self.device)-.3
        self.vel_command_b[self.is_standing_env,:]=0.

def boundary_timeout(env):
    # Explicit finite route boundary is a truncation, never hidden task success.
    xy=env.scene['robot'].data.root_pos_w[:,:2]
    anchor=getattr(env,'_rough_spawn_xy',env.scene.env_origins[:,:2])
    return (xy-anchor).abs().max(-1).values > 2.

def inactive_rolling(env, speed_scale=.15, yaw_min=3.5, support_weight=.25):
    cmd=env.command_manager.get_command('twist')
    if bool((cmd[:,2].abs()>1e-6).any()) or bool((cmd[:,1].abs()>1e-6).any()):
        raise RuntimeError('Intro command contract violated; flat rolling proxy not valid for terrain spin')
    # Original pure-yaw mask is false on EVERY new terrain command. Do not
    # instantiate a flat-circle contact proxy and claim terrain material slip.
    return torch.zeros(env.num_envs,device=env.device)
